note: Quantities are for `serves` people. `qty` is in `unit` (g, ml or each); `amount` is the same quantity as the app shows it. `cupboard` items are assumed in stock.

recipes.title: Chipotle chicken tacos with pineapple salsa
recipes.blurb: Smoky, sticky chicken in warm tortillas with a sharp pineapple and red onion salsa.
steps: Mix the chipotle paste, smoked paprika, cumin, garlic, half the lime juice, half the oil and a pinch of salt in a bowl. Stir the chicken through and leave it while you make the salsa.
For the salsa, combine the pineapple, half the red onion, the chili and most of the cilantro with a squeeze of lime, a pinch of salt and pepper.
Stir the yogurt with the rest of the lime juice and a pinch of salt to make a cooling drizzle.
Heat the remaining oil in a large frying pan over a high heat. Fry the chicken for 7 to 8 minutes, turning, until cooked through with sticky charred edges.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or microwave for 30 seconds. Fill with chicken, a spoonful of salsa, the lime yogurt, the remaining red onion and a scatter of cilantro.

recipes.title: Beef and bean burritos with lime rice
recipes.blurb: Spiced beef and kidney beans rolled up with cheddar and zesty rice, then crisped in the pan.
steps: Rinse the rice, then cook it in plenty of boiling salted water for 10 to 12 minutes. Drain and steam dry for a few minutes.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large frying pan and cook the onion and pepper for 6 minutes until softened. Add the garlic, chili powder, cumin and paprika and stir for 1 minute.
Add the ground beef and brown it hard for 5 minutes, breaking it up. Pour in the tomatoes, beans and jalapenos and simmer for 10 minutes until thick. Season well.
Stir the zest and juice of the lime and the cilantro through the rice with a pinch of salt.
Lay the tortillas flat. Spoon rice, beef and bean mix, cheddar and a little yogurt down the middle of each, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Wipe out the pan and toast the burritos seam-side down over a medium heat for 2 minutes each side until golden. Serve with the remaining yogurt.

recipes.title: Black bean and sweet potato enchiladas
recipes.blurb: Roasted sweet potato and black beans rolled in tortillas, baked under tomato sauce and melted cheddar.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Roast the sweet potato on a tray with half the oil, half the cumin, half the paprika and a pinch of salt for 20 minutes until tender and caramelised at the edges.
Meanwhile, soften the onion in the remaining oil in a saucepan for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, chili powder and remaining cumin and paprika, then the passata. Simmer for 8 minutes and season.
Tip the roasted sweet potato into a bowl with the black beans and spinach, and crush a little with a fork so it holds together.
Spread a few spoonfuls of sauce in a baking dish. Fill each tortilla with the sweet potato mix, roll up and nestle seam-side down in the dish.
Pour over the rest of the sauce, scatter with cheddar and bake for 12 to 15 minutes until bubbling and golden.
Stir the lime juice into the yogurt. Serve the enchiladas with the lime yogurt and cilantro.

recipes.title: Halloumi and pepper quesadillas
recipes.blurb: Crisp tortillas packed with squeaky halloumi, charred peppers and cheddar, with a quick avocado salsa.
steps: Heat half the oil in a large frying pan over a high heat. Fry the peppers and half the onion for 5 minutes until blistered, adding the cumin and paprika for the last minute. Tip into a bowl.
In the same pan, fry the halloumi for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until golden on most sides. Add it to the peppers with the jalapenos and cheddar and toss.
For the salsa, mix the avocado, tomatoes, remaining onion, cilantro, half the lime juice, salt and pepper.
Spread the filling over half of each tortilla and fold over. Wipe the pan, add a drop of the remaining oil and toast each quesadilla for 2 minutes per side until crisp and the cheese has melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with the salsa and the yogurt loosened with the remaining lime juice.

recipes.title: Smoky black bean tacos with lime avocado
recipes.blurb: Spiced black beans piled into warm tortillas with crushed lime avocado and crunchy red cabbage.

ingredients.name: Black beans (15 oz can)
ingredients.prep: drained, liquid from the can kept

steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat. Add the garlic, cumin, paprika and red pepper flakes and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the black beans with 3 tablespoons of liquid from the can. Cook for 5 minutes, crushing about a third of the beans with the back of a spoon, until thick and glossy. Season.
Toss the red cabbage with the juice of half a lime and a pinch of salt. Mix the onion and tomatoes with half the cilantro and the juice of half a lime.
Mash the avocado with the juice of the remaining lime, the rest of the cilantro, salt and pepper.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan. Fill with the beans, avocado, tomato salsa and red cabbage.

recipes.title: Hot chipotle shrimp tacos with lime slaw
recipes.blurb: Fiery chipotle shrimp in soft tortillas with a cooling crunchy cabbage and carrot slaw.
steps: Toss the shrimp with the chipotle paste, paprika, red pepper flakes, garlic, half the oil and the juice of half a lime. Leave for 10 minutes.
Mix the cabbage, carrot, green onions, most of the cilantro and the red chili with the juice of one lime, the yogurt, salt and pepper.
Heat the remaining oil in a large frying pan over a high heat. Fry the shrimp for 2 to 3 minutes each side until pink and lightly charred.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or the microwave.
Fill the tortillas with slaw and shrimp, then finish with the last of the cilantro and the remaining lime cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Orange and lime pork tacos with pickled onion
recipes.blurb: Quick-marinated pork steaks sliced into tacos with sweet-sharp pink pickled onions.
steps: Squeeze the juice of the orange and the lime into a bowl. Whisk in the garlic, cumin, oregano, chili powder, chipotle paste, half the oil and a good pinch of salt, then turn the pork steaks in it for 10 minutes.
Put the sliced onion in a small bowl with the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt. Scrunch with your fingers and leave to turn pink.

Heat a large frying pan over a high heat. Lift the pork from the marinade, pat dry and fry for 4 to 5 minutes each side until cooked through and well browned. Pour the marinade into the pan for the last minute to glaze.
Rest the pork for 3 minutes, then slice thinly.
Warm the tortillas and fill with pork, pickled onion, avocado and cilantro.

recipes.title: Chipotle cauliflower tacos with corn salsa
recipes.blurb: Roasted smoky cauliflower in warm tortillas with corn salsa and lime avocado.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Whisk the chipotle paste, cumin, garlic, oil and a pinch of salt in a large bowl and toss the cauliflower through until coated.
Spread on a large tray and roast for 25 minutes, turning once, until tender with dark crisp edges.
Mix the corn, onion, juice of one lime and the cilantro for the salsa. Season with salt and pepper.
Mash the avocado with the juice of the remaining lime and a pinch of salt.
Warm the tortillas in the oven for the last 2 minutes. Fill with avocado, cauliflower and corn salsa.

recipes.title: Turkey picadillo with fluffy rice
recipes.blurb: Gently spiced ground turkey with peppers, olives and raisins, a sweet-savoury Latin classic over rice.
steps: Cook the rice in plenty of boiling salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, then drain.
Heat the oil in a large pan and soften the onion and pepper for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, cumin, paprika, oregano and tomato paste and stir for 1 minute.
Add the turkey and cook over a high heat for 6 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink remains.
Pour in the tomatoes and ½ cup of water with the crumbled bouillon cube. Add the raisins and olives, then simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Stir in the peas for the last 2 minutes, season well and finish with the cilantro. Serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Cuban-style black beans and rice
recipes.blurb: Garlicky black beans simmered with peppers and bay, served with rice and creamy avocado.

ingredients.name: Black beans (15 oz can)
ingredients.prep: drained, liquid from one can kept

steps: Cook the rice in plenty of boiling salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, then drain and keep warm.
Heat the oil in a saucepan and cook the onion and green bell pepper for 8 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, cumin and oregano and stir for 1 minute.
Add the beans, the liquid from one can, ⅔ cup of water, the bay leaf and the crumbled bouillon cube. Simmer for 15 minutes, mashing a few beans against the side of the pan to thicken.
Stir in the vinegar, season well and remove the bay leaf.
Serve the beans over the rice with avocado, green onions, cilantro and wedges of lime.

recipes.title: Chimichurri steak with crispy baby potatoes
recipes.blurb: Seared rump steak with a punchy parsley, garlic and chili sauce and roasted baby potatoes.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp of the oil and a pinch of salt on a tray and roast for 30 minutes, turning once, until crisp and golden.
For the chimichurri, stir the parsley, cilantro, garlic, chili, vinegar, oregano and 1½ tbsp of oil with a pinch of salt and pepper. Leave to sit.
Take the steak out of the fridge 15 minutes before cooking and season it all over.
Heat a heavy frying pan until very hot. Sear the steak for 3 to 4 minutes each side for medium, then rest it for 5 minutes.
Toss the tomatoes and arugula with a spoonful of chimichurri. Slice the steak against the grain and serve with the potatoes, salad and the rest of the sauce.

recipes.title: Garlic mojo white fish with lime rice
recipes.blurb: Flaky white fish bathed in warm garlic, orange and lime, with fluffy rice and a tomato avocado salad.
steps: Cook the rice in boiling salted water for 10 to 12 minutes. Drain, then stir through the zest of one lime and a squeeze of its juice.

Season the fish with cumin, oregano, salt and pepper. Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large non-stick frying pan and fry the fish for 3 to 4 minutes each side until just cooked and flaking. Move to warm plates.
Add the remaining oil to the pan with the garlic and cook gently for 1 minute until pale gold. Pour in the juice of the orange and one lime and bubble for 1 minute.
Toss the avocado, tomatoes, half the onion and the cilantro with a pinch of salt.
Spoon the warm mojo over the fish and serve with the lime rice, salad and the remaining onion.

recipes.title: Double beef burgers with paprika wedges
recipes.blurb: Thin, crisp-edged beef patties with melted cheddar, burger sauce and smoky potato wedges.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the wedges with 1½ tbsp of the oil, the paprika and a good pinch of salt and roast for 30 to 35 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Mix the mayonnaise, ketchup and mustard into a sauce. Season the ground beef lightly and shape it into four thin balls.

Heat a large frying pan until very hot with the remaining oil. Squash each ball flat with a spatula, season, and cook for 2 minutes until crusted. Flip, top two patties with cheddar and cook for 1 minute more.
Toast the buns cut-side down in the pan for 30 seconds.
Build the burgers with sauce, lettuce, tomato, onion and two patties each. Serve with the wedges.

recipes.title: Cauliflower and cheddar mac-style bake
recipes.blurb: Fusilli and tender cauliflower in a mustardy cheddar sauce under a golden crumb.
steps: Heat the broiler to high. Cook the fusilli in boiling salted water for 7 minutes, adding the cauliflower for the last 4 minutes. Drain.
Melt the butter in a saucepan, add the garlic and stir for 20 seconds, then the flour. Cook for 1 minute, stirring.
Add the milk a splash at a time, whisking, then simmer for 4 to 5 minutes until the sauce coats a spoon. Off the heat, stir in three quarters of the cheddar, the mustard, salt and pepper.
Fold the pasta and cauliflower into the sauce and tip into an ovenproof dish. Scatter over the tomatoes.
Mix the rest of the cheddar with the panko and paprika, sprinkle on top and broil for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.title: Fiery Cajun shrimp and rice skillet
recipes.blurb: Hot, smoky shrimp cooked with peppers, celery and rice in one pan, finished with lemon.
steps: Toss the shrimp with half the Cajun seasoning and the red pepper flakes. Set aside.
Heat the oil in a large lidded frying pan. Cook the onion, peppers and celery for 8 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and remaining Cajun seasoning and stir for 1 minute.
Stir in the rice, tomatoes, red chili and 1¼ cups of water with the crumbled bouillon cube. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook on a low heat for 12 minutes.
Nestle the shrimp into the rice, cover again and cook for 5 minutes until the shrimp are pink and the rice is tender, adding a splash of water if it looks dry.
Season, squeeze over the lemon and scatter with green onions and parsley.

recipes.title: BBQ chicken, corn and potato traybake
recipes.blurb: Sticky barbecue chicken thighs roasted with corn, baby potatoes and peppers, with lemony yogurt.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Put the potatoes on a large tray with half the oil and a pinch of salt and roast for 10 minutes.
Mix the barbecue sauce, paprika and garlic with the chicken. Add the chicken, corn, onion and pepper to the tray with the remaining oil and toss.
Roast for 25 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is cooked through and sticky and the potatoes are golden.
Stir a squeeze of lemon juice, a little zest and the green onions into the yogurt with salt and pepper.
Serve the traybake straight from the tray with the lemony yogurt.

recipes.title: Smoky BBQ chickpea and sweet potato bowl
recipes.blurb: Roasted barbecue chickpeas and sweet potato over quinoa with red cabbage slaw and avocado.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potato with 1 tbsp of the oil, half the paprika, salt and pepper on a large tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Toss the chickpeas with the barbecue sauce and the rest of the paprika, add to the tray and roast for 15 minutes more until sticky and crisp at the edges.
Meanwhile, simmer the quinoa in 1¼ cups of salted water for 12 to 15 minutes until the water is absorbed, then fluff with a fork.
Toss the cabbage and carrot with half the lime juice, the remaining oil and a pinch of salt.
Divide the quinoa and spinach between bowls, top with the sweet potato, chickpeas, slaw and avocado, and squeeze over the remaining lime.

recipes.title: Black bean burgers with lime slaw
recipes.blurb: Smoky black bean and oat patties in brioche buns with avocado and crunchy yogurt slaw.
steps: Mash the beans in a bowl, leaving some whole for texture. Mix in the oats, onion, garlic, paprika, cumin, chili powder, egg, salt and pepper until it holds together.
Shape into two fat patties and chill for 10 minutes to firm up.
Mix the cabbage, carrot, yogurt, lime juice and cilantro for the slaw and season.
Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Cook the patties for 5 minutes each side until crisp and heated through, turning carefully.
Toast the buns, then build with slaw, avocado and a patty.

recipes.title: Jerk chicken with coconut rice and peas
recipes.blurb: Hot, fragrant jerk-marinated chicken thighs with creamy coconut rice and kidney beans.
steps: Blitz or mash the ginger, garlic, half the green onions, chili, thyme, cinnamon, pepper, sugar, soy sauce, lime juice and oil into a rough paste. Rub it all over the chicken and leave for at least 15 minutes.
Heat the oven to 425°F. Roast the chicken on a tray for 25 to 30 minutes, turning once, until cooked through and charred in places.

Meanwhile, rinse the rice. Put it in a pan with the coconut milk, ⅔ cup of water, the kidney beans, the remaining green onions and the salt. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes.
Take the rice off the heat and leave it covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Rest the chicken for 3 minutes, slice and serve over the rice and peas.

recipes.title: Jerk sweet potato and kidney bean coconut stew
recipes.blurb: Sweet potato and kidney beans simmered in jerk-spiced coconut broth with spinach, served over rice.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the onion and pepper for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger, chili, thyme, cinnamon and black pepper and stir for 1 minute.
Add the sweet potato, kidney beans, coconut milk, ¾ cup of water and the crumbled bouillon cube. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook for 18 to 20 minutes until the sweet potato is tender.
Meanwhile, cook the rice in boiling salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain.
Stir the spinach into the stew until wilted, then add the lime juice and salt to taste. Crush a few pieces of sweet potato to thicken it if you like.
Serve the stew over the rice.

recipes.title: Jerk salmon with mango salsa and rice
recipes.blurb: Spiced, sticky salmon fillets with a bright mango and red onion salsa and jasmine rice.
steps: Mix the garlic, ginger, half the chili, thyme, cinnamon, sugar, soy sauce, the juice of half a lime and half the oil. Spread over the salmon and leave for 10 minutes.
Cook the rice in boiling salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, then drain. Stir through the green onions.
Mix the mango, red onion, cilantro, the remaining chili and the juice of one lime with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Heat the remaining oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat and cook the salmon skin-side down for 4 minutes, then flip for 2 to 3 minutes until just cooked through and glazed.
Serve the salmon on the rice with the mango salsa and a wedge of the remaining lime.

recipes.title: Caribbean coconut chickpea and squash curry
recipes.blurb: Creamy, mildly spiced curry of butternut squash and chickpeas with spinach and lime.

ingredients.name: Butternut squash
ingredients.prep: peeled and cut into ¾ inch chunks

steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and soften the onion for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger, curry powder, thyme and half the chili and stir for 1 minute.
Add the squash, chickpeas, coconut milk, ½ cup of water and the crumbled bouillon cube. Bring to a simmer and cook, partly covered, for 20 minutes until the squash is soft.
Meanwhile, cook the rice in boiling salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain.
Stir the spinach into the curry until wilted, then add the lime juice and salt to taste.
Serve over the rice, topped with the cilantro and the remaining chili.

recipes.title: Leek and mushroom puff pastry pie
recipes.blurb: Soft leeks and browned mushrooms in a thyme creme fraiche sauce under a crisp, golden pastry lid.

ingredients.name: Vegetable bouillon cube
ingredients.prep: dissolved in ½ cup boiling water

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Melt the butter in a wide, ovenproof frying pan over a medium-high heat and fry the mushrooms for 6 minutes without moving them too much, until deeply browned.
Add the leeks, garlic and thyme with a pinch of salt and cook for 6–8 minutes until the leeks have collapsed and turned silky.

Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then pour in the stock a splash at a time. Simmer for 2 minutes, then take off the heat and stir through the creme fraiche, mustard and plenty of pepper. Let it cool for a few minutes.
Unroll the pastry and lay it over the pan, tucking the edges in against the sides. Cut a small slit in the centre, brush with beaten egg and bake for 20–22 minutes until puffed and deep golden.
Ten minutes before the pie is ready, boil the green beans for 4–5 minutes until just tender and drain well.
Rest the pie for 3 minutes, then serve in wedges with the buttered beans.

recipes.title: Sausages with buttery mash and onion gravy
recipes.blurb: Browned pork sausages on creamy mash with sweet onion gravy and a heap of peas.
steps: Put the potatoes in a pan of cold salted water, bring to the boil and simmer for 15–18 minutes until a knife slides through with no resistance.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat and cook the sausages for 14–16 minutes, turning often, until evenly browned and cooked through. Lift out onto a plate.
Add the onions to the sausage fat with a pinch of salt and cook for 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft and golden.
Stir the flour and mustard into the onions for 1 minute, then pour in the stock gradually. Simmer for 5 minutes until glossy and thick enough to coat a spoon.
Drain the potatoes, return to the warm pan and mash with the butter, milk, salt and pepper until smooth. Boil the peas for 3 minutes in a separate pan.
Serve the mash with the sausages, peas and a generous pour of onion gravy.

recipes.title: Salmon and dill fishcakes with a lemony pea salad
recipes.blurb: Crisp-crumbed salmon and potato cakes with a bright pea and leaf salad and caper creme fraiche.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until tender, drain and leave to steam dry for 5 minutes, then mash roughly.
Season the salmon, wrap it loosely in foil and bake for 10–12 minutes until just cooked. Flake the flesh away from the skin and discard the skin.
Fold the salmon through the mash with the green onions, dill, the zest of half the lemon and a good grind of pepper. Shape into 4 thick patties.
Dip each patty in the flour, then the beaten egg, then the panko. Fry in the vegetable oil over a medium heat for 3–4 minutes each side until crisp and golden.
Cook the peas in boiling water for 3 minutes, drain, then toss with the salad leaves, olive oil and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Stir the capers and a little lemon zest into the creme fraiche. Serve the fishcakes with the pea salad, the caper sauce and the remaining lemon in wedges.

recipes.title: Crispy cod with crushed potatoes and caper peas
recipes.blurb: Oven-crisp panko fish on buttery crushed baby potatoes with caper peas and a lemony creme fraiche dip.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and put a baking tray in to heat. Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15–18 minutes until tender.
Mix the panko with the vegetable oil and a pinch of salt. Cut the fish into 2 pieces, season, then coat in flour, beaten egg and the oily crumbs, pressing firmly.
Slide the fish onto the hot tray and bake for 12–14 minutes until the crumb is golden and the fish flakes easily.
Drain the potatoes, tip them back into the pan with the olive oil, the zest of half the lemon and the parsley, and crush each one lightly with a fork. Season well.
Boil the peas for 3 minutes, drain, and stir through the capers and a squeeze of lemon.
Stir some lemon zest and juice into the creme fraiche. Serve the fish with the potatoes, peas and the dip.

recipes.title: Lentil and mushroom cottage pie
recipes.blurb: Rich puy lentil and mushroom filling under a golden olive oil mash, with peas on the side.

ingredients.name: Vegetable bouillon cube
ingredients.prep: dissolved in ¾ cup boiling water

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15–18 minutes until completely tender.
Meanwhile, heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large pan and cook the onion, carrots and mushrooms over a medium-high heat for 8–10 minutes until the mushrooms have given up their water and started to brown.
Add the garlic, thyme and tomato paste and stir for 1 minute. Tip in the lentils, balsamic and stock and simmer for 8 minutes until thick and saucy. Season well and spoon into a baking dish.
Drain the potatoes and mash with the remaining oil, the oat drink, salt and pepper until smooth. Spread over the filling and rough up the top with a fork.
Bake for 20 minutes until the edges are bubbling and the peaks of mash are golden. Boil the peas for 3 minutes just before serving.
Rest the pie for 5 minutes and serve with the peas.

recipes.title: Chicken and leek pie with buttery kale
recipes.blurb: Tender chicken and leeks in a creamy mustard sauce under flaky puff pastry, with garlicky kale.

ingredients.name: Chicken bouillon cube
ingredients.prep: dissolved in ½ cup boiling water

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Melt 1 tbsp of the butter in an ovenproof pan over a medium-high heat and brown the chicken for 4–5 minutes, seasoning as it cooks. Lift out.
Add the leeks and thyme to the pan with a pinch of salt and cook gently for 6 minutes until soft.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then gradually add the stock. Simmer for 2 minutes, then return the chicken, stir in the creme fraiche and mustard and take off the heat.
Cover with the pastry, tucking in the edges, cut a slit in the middle and brush with egg. Bake for 20–22 minutes until risen and deep golden.
For the last 5 minutes, melt the remaining butter in a frying pan, fry the garlic for 30 seconds, add the kale with a splash of water and cook until wilted and tender.
Serve wedges of pie with the buttery kale.

recipes.title: Smoked mackerel and new potato salad
recipes.blurb: Flaky smoked mackerel, warm baby potatoes, crunchy radish and cucumber in a dill and mustard dressing.
steps: Boil the potatoes in well-salted water for 12–15 minutes until tender, then drain and leave to steam for a couple of minutes.
While they cook, whisk the creme fraiche, mustard, olive oil, the zest and juice of half the lemon, half the dill and a good pinch of pepper into a loose dressing.
Toss the warm potatoes with about half the dressing so they soak it up.
Arrange the salad leaves, cucumber, radish and green onions on plates and top with the potatoes and flaked mackerel.
Spoon over the rest of the dressing, scatter with the remaining dill and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Cheddar rarebit toasts with blistered tomatoes
recipes.blurb: Thick sourdough under a bubbling mustardy cheddar topping, with sweet blistered tomatoes and wilted spinach.
steps: Heat the broiler to high. Toast the sourdough on both sides on a baking tray until just golden.
Beat the cheddar with the creme fraiche, mustard, flour, egg yolk and plenty of black pepper into a thick paste.
Spread the paste generously right to the edges of the toast and broil for 3–4 minutes until bubbling and flecked with brown.
Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a frying pan over a high heat and cook the tomatoes for 4 minutes until blistered and starting to burst. Add the balsamic and a pinch of salt.
Add the spinach and let it wilt for 1 minute.
Serve the rarebit toasts with the tomatoes and spinach, scattered with chives.

recipes.title: Shepherd's pie with parsnip mash
recipes.blurb: Rosemary ground lamb and vegetables under a sweet parsnip and potato mash with a cheddar crust.

ingredients.name: Beef bouillon cube
ingredients.prep: dissolved in ¾ cup boiling water

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Boil the potatoes and parsnips together in salted water for 15–18 minutes until very tender.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large pan over a high heat and brown the lamb for 5 minutes, breaking it up. Add the onion, carrot and celery and cook for 6 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, rosemary, tomato paste and flour for 1 minute, then add the stock. Simmer for 10 minutes until thick, stir in the peas and season well. Spoon into a baking dish.
Drain the potatoes and parsnips and mash with the butter, milk, salt and pepper.
Spread the mash over the lamb, rough up the top with a fork and scatter with the cheddar.
Bake for 18–20 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges, and rest for 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Mustard roast roots with butter beans and kale
recipes.blurb: Caramelised carrots, parsnips and red onion roasted with rosemary, butter beans and a sharp mustard dressing.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the carrots, parsnips and red onion on a large tray with 1½ tbsp of the oil, the rosemary, salt and pepper.
Roast for 25 minutes, turning once, until golden at the edges and tender.
Add the butter beans and kale to the tray, drizzle with a little more oil and roast for a final 8–10 minutes until the kale is crisp at the tips and the beans are warm.
Whisk the mustard, vinegar, maple syrup and remaining oil with a pinch of salt.
Scatter the walnuts over the tray, drizzle with the dressing and serve straight away.

recipes.title: Peppercorn steak with oven fries and green beans
recipes.blurb: Seared rump steak in a creamy cracked-pepper and shallot sauce, with crisp oven fries and buttery beans.

ingredients.name: Beef bouillon cube
ingredients.prep: dissolved in ½ cup boiling water

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the fries on a large tray with 1½ tbsp of the oil and a good pinch of salt, and roast for 30–35 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp and golden.
Take the steak out of the fridge 20 minutes before cooking and pat dry. Season with salt and press half the cracked pepper into both sides.
Heat the remaining oil in a heavy frying pan over a high heat. Sear the steak for 3 minutes each side for medium-rare, then rest on a plate.
Lower the heat, add the butter and shallot to the pan and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in the remaining pepper, stock and mustard, then simmer for 3 minutes until reduced by half.
Add the cream and any steak resting juices and simmer for 2 minutes until the sauce coats a spoon.
Boil the green beans for 4 minutes and drain. Slice the steak, and serve with the sauce, fries, beans and parsley.

recipes.title: Leek and potato gratin with a mustard leaf salad
recipes.blurb: Thin-sliced potatoes and leeks baked in garlicky cream under a golden cheese crust, with a sharp salad.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and butter a medium baking dish. Warm the cream, milk, garlic, thyme, half the salt and plenty of pepper in a pan until just steaming.
Layer the potatoes and leeks in the dish, seasoning each layer lightly with salt.
Pour over the warm cream mixture, pressing the layers down so they are mostly submerged. Cover tightly with foil.
Bake covered for 30 minutes, then uncover, scatter over the cheddar and parmesan, and bake for 15–18 minutes more until deep golden and the potatoes are completely tender.
Whisk the mustard, vinegar and olive oil with a pinch of salt and toss with the salad leaves.
Let the gratin settle for 5 minutes, then serve with the salad.

recipes.title: Goats' cheese, beets and walnut bistro salad
recipes.blurb: Warm honeyed goats' cheese toasts on peppery leaves with beets, green beans and toasted walnuts.
steps: Heat the broiler to high. Boil the green beans for 4 minutes, drain and refresh under cold water.
Whisk the shallot, mustard, vinegar and 1½ tbsp of the olive oil with a pinch of salt and pepper to make a dressing.
Toast the baguette slices under the broiler on one side. Turn them over, top each with a little goats' cheese, drizzle with honey and broil for 2–3 minutes until bubbling and lightly browned.
Toast the walnuts in a dry frying pan for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Toss the leaves, beans and beets with most of the dressing and divide between plates.
Top with the warm goats' cheese toasts, scatter over the walnuts and chives, and drizzle with the remaining dressing and oil.

recipes.title: French onion soup with cheesy baguette toasts
recipes.blurb: Slow-cooked sweet onions in a thyme broth, topped with bubbling cheese on crusty baguette.
steps: Melt the butter with the oil in a large, heavy pan over a medium heat. Add the onions and a pinch of salt and cook for 25–30 minutes, stirring every few minutes, until deep golden brown and jammy.
Add the garlic and thyme for 1 minute, then stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute more.
Pour in the stock gradually, stirring, then add the balsamic and mustard. Simmer for 10 minutes and season with pepper.
Heat the broiler. Toast the baguette slices on one side, turn, and cover with the cheddar and parmesan. Broil for 2–3 minutes until bubbling and flecked with brown.
Ladle the soup into bowls and float the cheesy toasts on top.

recipes.title: Provencal ratatouille with white beans and crusty bread
recipes.blurb: Eggplant, zucchini and peppers stewed in tomato and thyme with creamy cannellini and basil.
steps: Heat half the oil in a large, wide pan over a medium-high heat and fry the eggplant for 8 minutes, stirring often, until golden and softened. Tip onto a plate.
Add the remaining oil and the onion, peppers and zucchini and cook for 8 minutes until beginning to soften and catch at the edges.
Stir in the garlic, thyme and tomato paste for 1 minute, then add the chopped tomatoes, a splash of water, the eggplant and a good pinch of salt.
Simmer gently for 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until the vegetables are tender and the sauce has thickened.
Stir through the cannellini beans, olives and balsamic and warm through for 3 minutes. Season to taste.
Serve topped with torn basil and the warm baguette.

recipes.title: Creamy mustard chicken with mushrooms and baby potatoes
recipes.blurb: Pan-seared chicken in a thyme, mustard and creme fraiche sauce with browned mushrooms and green beans.

ingredients.name: Chicken bouillon cube
ingredients.prep: dissolved in ½ cup boiling water

steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 12–15 minutes until tender, adding the green beans for the last 4 minutes. Drain and toss with half the butter.
Meanwhile, season the chicken and heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Cook for 4–5 minutes each side until golden and cooked through, then lift onto a plate.
Add the remaining butter and the mushrooms to the pan and fry for 5 minutes until browned. Add the garlic and thyme for 30 seconds.
Pour in the stock and bubble for 3 minutes, then stir in the creme fraiche and mustard and simmer for 2 minutes until silky.
Return the chicken and its juices to the sauce for a minute. Serve with the potatoes, beans and a scatter of parsley.

recipes.title: Hungarian-style beef and paprika goulash
recipes.blurb: Beef and peppers slowly simmered in smoky paprika and tomato with potatoes, finished with creme fraiche.

ingredients.name: White potatoes
ingredients.prep: peeled and cut into ¾ inch chunks

steps: Heat the oil in a large casserole or deep pan over a high heat. Season the beef and brown it in two batches for 2–3 minutes each, then lift out.
Lower the heat to medium, add the onions with a pinch of salt and cook for 8 minutes until soft and golden.
Stir in the garlic, both paprikas and the tomato paste for 1 minute. Take care not to let the paprika scorch, as it turns bitter.

Add the chopped tomatoes, stock, bay leaf, peppers, potatoes and the beef with its juices. Bring to the boil, then cover and simmer gently for 30 minutes, stirring now and then, until the beef and potatoes are tender.
Uncover for the last 5 minutes if the sauce is thin. Season to taste and remove the bay leaf.
Serve in bowls with a spoonful of creme fraiche and chopped parsley.

recipes.title: Pork schnitzel with potato salad and apple cabbage slaw
recipes.blurb: Thin, crisp-crumbed pork with lemon, warm mustardy potatoes and a crunchy red cabbage and apple slaw.
steps: Boil the potatoes in well-salted water for 12–15 minutes until tender. Drain, toss with the butter, mustard and half the chives and keep warm.
Toss the red cabbage and apple with the vinegar, olive oil, the juice of half the lemon and a good pinch of salt, and leave to soften for 10 minutes.
Season the pork and coat each piece in flour, then beaten egg, then panko, pressing the crumbs on firmly.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat until a crumb sizzles immediately. Fry the schnitzels for 2–3 minutes each side until deep golden, in batches if needed.
Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with a pinch of salt.
Serve with lemon wedges, the warm potatoes and the slaw, sprinkled with the remaining chives.

recipes.title: Nordic dill and mustard salmon with a cucumber pickle
recipes.blurb: Honey-mustard glazed salmon with dill baby potatoes and a quick sweet-sharp cucumber and radish pickle.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Boil the potatoes in salted water for 12–15 minutes until tender.
Stir the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt together until dissolved, then toss with the cucumber and radish and leave to pickle while everything cooks.
Mix the mustard and honey and spread over the salmon. Place on a lined tray, drizzle with the oil and roast for 10–12 minutes until just cooked and flaking.
Stir half the dill, the chives, a little lemon zest and juice and a pinch of salt into the creme fraiche.
Drain the potatoes and toss with the remaining dill and pepper.
Serve the salmon on the potatoes with the pickle and herb creme fraiche, plus lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Portuguese-style paprika chicken and potato traybake
recipes.blurb: Chicken thighs roasted with garlic, lemon, smoked paprika and chili over crisp potatoes, with a tomato salad.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Mix 1½ tbsp of the oil with both paprikas, the red pepper flakes, the zest and juice of half the lemon, and a good pinch of salt and pepper.
Toss the chicken and potatoes in the spiced oil on a large tray, then scatter over the onion, pepper and garlic cloves.
Roast for 35–40 minutes, turning everything once halfway, until the chicken is cooked through and the potatoes are crisp and rust-coloured.
Toss the tomatoes and cucumber with the vinegar, remaining oil and a pinch of salt.
Squeeze the remaining lemon over the tray, scatter with parsley and serve with the salad.

recipes.title: Beets and cabbage soup with dill creme fraiche
recipes.blurb: A ruby, sweet-sour Eastern European-style soup of beets, potato and cabbage, swirled with dill creme fraiche.

ingredients.name: White potatoes
ingredients.prep: peeled and cut into small cubes

steps: Heat the oil in a large pan over a medium heat and cook the onion and carrots for 6 minutes until starting to soften. Add the garlic and tomato paste and stir for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, beets, bay leaf and stock. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 12 minutes.
Stir in the cabbage and simmer for a further 8–10 minutes until everything is tender.
Add the vinegar, then taste and season with salt and pepper, adding a splash more vinegar if you want it sharper. Remove the bay leaf.
Stir half the dill into the creme fraiche. Ladle the soup into bowls, swirl in the dill creme fraiche and scatter with the remaining dill.
Serve with the bread, toasted if you like.

recipes.title: Smoky chickpea and kale stew with garlicky sourdough
recipes.blurb: Chickpeas, potato and kale in a paprika tomato broth with a hint of chili, served with garlic-rubbed sourdough.

ingredients.name: White potatoes
ingredients.prep: peeled and cut into ¾ inch chunks

steps: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large pan over a medium heat and cook the onion for 6 minutes until soft. Add the crushed garlic, smoked paprika and red pepper flakes and stir for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, chopped tomatoes, stock and bay leaf. Bring to the boil, cover and simmer for 12 minutes.
Stir in the chickpeas and simmer, uncovered, for 8 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the broth has thickened a little. Crush a few chickpeas against the side of the pan to thicken it.
Add the kale and cook for 4–5 minutes until wilted and tender. Season with salt, pepper and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Toast the sourdough, rub with the cut garlic clove and drizzle with the remaining oil.
Ladle the stew into bowls, scatter with parsley and serve with the garlic toast.

recipes.title: Ginger beef and broccoli stir-fry
recipes.blurb: Tender beef strips and crisp broccoli in a glossy ginger and oyster sauce, served over fluffy jasmine rice.
steps: Rinse the rice, then cook it in a lidded pan with 1¼ cups of water: bring to the boil, cover, turn the heat right down and cook for 12 minutes. Leave covered off the heat.
Toss the beef with the cornstarch, half the soy sauce and the black pepper. In a small bowl, stir the oyster sauce with the rest of the soy and ¼ cup of water.
Heat half the oil in a wok over a high heat. Fry the beef for 2 minutes until browned, then tip it onto a plate.
Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the broccoli with the green onion whites for 3 minutes, adding a splash of water to steam it slightly.
Add the ginger and garlic for 30 seconds, then pour in the sauce and return the beef. Bubble for 1 minute until glossy.
Serve over the rice, scattered with the green onion greens.

recipes.title: Sweet and sour chicken with peppers
recipes.blurb: Crisp-edged chicken, pineapple and peppers tossed in a bright, tangy sauce you can balance to taste.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 1¼ cups of water: boil, cover, reduce the heat to its lowest and cook for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat.
Stir the ketchup, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar and 4 tbsp of the pineapple juice or water together for the sauce.
Toss the chicken in 1 tbsp of the cornstarch and the salt. Fry it in half the oil over a medium-high heat for 6 to 7 minutes until golden and cooked through, then set aside.
Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the onion and peppers for 4 minutes so they keep some bite.
Return the chicken, add the pineapple and pour in the sauce. Mix the remaining cornstarch with 1 tbsp of water, stir it in and bubble for 1 minute until thick and glossy.
Spoon over the rice and serve.

recipes.title: Fiery mapo-style tofu with mushrooms
recipes.blurb: Silky tofu and savoury mushrooms in a numbing-hot, chili-oil sauce. Properly spicy and very vegan.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 1¼ cups of water: boil, cover, turn right down and cook for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat.
Cover the tofu cubes with boiling water and the salt and leave for 5 minutes to firm up, then drain gently.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok over a high heat. Fry the mushrooms for 5 minutes until deeply browned and dry.
Add the garlic, ginger, green onion whites, red pepper flakes and the chili oil, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the soy sauce, sugar, black pepper and ¾ cup of water. Slide in the tofu and simmer for 4 minutes.
Mix the cornstarch with 2 tbsp of cold water, stir it in and cook for 1 minute until the sauce clings. Serve over the rice with the green onion greens.

recipes.title: Egg fried rice with peas and green onion
recipes.blurb: Fast, satisfying fried rice with soft scrambled egg, sweet peas and toasted sesame oil.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 1¼ cups of water: boil, cover, reduce to the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then spread it on a tray to cool and dry for 5 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the salt. Heat half the vegetable oil in a wok over a high heat and scramble the eggs for 30 seconds until just set, then tip them out.
Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the carrot and green onion whites for 2 minutes.
Add the garlic and rice, pressing it against the hot wok and tossing for 3 minutes until it begins to crisp.
Stir in the peas, soy sauce and pepper and cook for 2 minutes. Fold the egg back in.
Finish with the sesame oil and the green onion greens.

recipes.title: Hoisin pork and bok choy noodles
recipes.blurb: Sticky hoisin pork strips with wilted bok choy and slippery egg noodles, a gentle-heat midweek favourite.
steps: Cook the noodles in boiling water to the packet time, drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk the hoisin, soy sauce, rice vinegar and 3 tbsp of water in a small bowl.
Heat half the oil in a wok over a high heat and fry the pork for 3 to 4 minutes until browned at the edges, then remove.
Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the carrot and bok choy stems for 2 minutes, then add the ginger, garlic and half the chili for 30 seconds.
Return the pork with the noodles, bok choy leaves and sauce. Toss for 2 minutes until everything is hot and coated.
Serve topped with the remaining chili.

recipes.title: Chicken katsu curry with rice
recipes.blurb: Crunchy panko chicken with a mild, sweet Japanese-style curry sauce and a quick cucumber pickle.

ingredients.name: Chicken breast
ingredients.prep: sliced in half horizontally to make 2 thin cutlets

steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 1¼ cups of water: boil, cover, reduce to the lowest heat for 12 minutes and rest off the heat. Toss the cucumber with the rice vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Soften the onion and carrot in 1 tbsp of the oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger, 2½ tbsp of the flour and the curry powder and stir for 1 minute.
Crumble in the bouillon cube, add 1½ cups of water, the soy sauce and the sugar. Simmer for 12 minutes, then blend with a stick blender until smooth, or leave chunky if you prefer.
Season the chicken with salt. Coat each piece in the remaining flour, then egg, then panko, pressing the crumbs on.
Heat the remaining oil in a frying pan over a medium heat and fry the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until deep golden and cooked through. Drain on paper towels.
Slice the chicken and serve over the rice with the curry sauce and cucumber pickle.

recipes.title: Teriyaki salmon and edamame rice bowl
recipes.blurb: Glazed salmon over sticky rice with edamame and crunchy cucumber. Ready in just over twenty minutes.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 1¼ cups of water: boil, cover, reduce to the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat. Cook the edamame in boiling water for 3 minutes and drain.
Stir the soy sauce, mirin, sugar and ginger together until the sugar dissolves.
Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the salmon for 3 minutes on one side until golden.
Turn the fillets, pour in the teriyaki mixture and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, spooning it over until sticky and the fish is just cooked.
Divide the rice between bowls and add the edamame and cucumber. Flake or slice the salmon on top, drizzle with the pan glaze and scatter over the green onion and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Miso-glazed eggplant rice bowl
recipes.blurb: Sweet-salty miso eggplant roasted until soft and caramelised, with rice, cucumber and sesame.

ingredients.name: Eggplant
ingredients.prep: halved lengthways, flesh scored in a criss-cross

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Brush the cut sides of the eggplant with 2 tbsp of the oil and roast cut-side down on a tray for 20 minutes until soft.
Meanwhile cook the rice in a lidded pan with 1¼ cups of water: boil, cover, reduce to the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat.
Whisk the miso, mirin, soy sauce and sugar with 1 tbsp of water until smooth.
Turn the eggplant cut-side up, spread the miso glaze over the flesh and roast for 8 to 10 minutes more until sticky and bubbling at the edges.
Serve the eggplant on the rice with the cucumber, green onion and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Miso tofu and mushroom udon broth
recipes.blurb: A light, savoury miso broth with chunky udon, golden tofu, mushrooms and bok choy.
steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a saucepan over a medium-high heat and fry the tofu for 5 minutes, turning until golden on most sides. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, fry the mushrooms and ginger for 4 minutes until lightly browned.
Add 3 cups of water, the crumbled bouillon cube, soy sauce and mirin and bring to a simmer.
Add the udon and bok choy and simmer for 3 minutes until the noodles are loose and hot.
Ladle a little broth into a cup, whisk in the miso until smooth and stir it back into the pan. Do not boil it again.
Divide into bowls, top with the tofu and green onion and finish with the sesame oil.

recipes.title: Gochujang pork rice bowl
recipes.blurb: Sticky, spicy ground pork over rice with quick-pickled cucumber and crunchy carrot.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 1¼ cups of water: boil, cover, reduce to the lowest heat for 12 minutes and rest off the heat.
Toss the cucumber with the rice vinegar and a pinch of the sugar and leave to pickle.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over a high heat and fry the pork, breaking it up, for 6 minutes until browned and any liquid has cooked off.
Add the garlic, ginger and half the green onion for 1 minute, then stir in the gochujang, soy sauce, sugar and 3 tbsp of water. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes until sticky.
Spoon the pork over the rice with the cucumber and carrot. Drizzle with the sesame oil and scatter over the sesame seeds and remaining green onion.

recipes.title: Veggie bibimbap with a fried egg
recipes.blurb: Rice topped with sesame spinach, carrots, mushrooms and a runny egg, finished with gochujang sauce.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 1¼ cups of water: boil, cover, reduce to the lowest heat for 12 minutes and rest off the heat.
Stir the gochujang, sugar, 1 tsp of the sesame oil and 2 tbsp of water into a sauce.
Wilt the spinach in a hot pan for 1 minute, squeeze out the water and toss with 1 tsp of soy sauce, a little sesame oil, the garlic and the salt.
Fry the carrot in 1 tbsp of the vegetable oil for 3 minutes, then remove. Fry the mushrooms in the same pan with the remaining soy sauce for 5 minutes until golden.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil over a medium-high heat for 2 to 3 minutes until the whites are crisp and the yolks runny.
Divide the rice between bowls, arrange the vegetables and cucumber on top and add an egg. Drizzle with the remaining sesame oil, scatter with sesame seeds and serve with the sauce to stir through.

recipes.title: Kimchi and crispy tofu fried rice
recipes.blurb: Tangy kimchi, golden tofu and gochujang-spiced rice in one wok. Hot, funky and fully vegan.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 1¼ cups of water: boil, cover, reduce to the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then spread out on a tray to cool and dry.
Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in a wok over a high heat and fry the tofu for 6 to 7 minutes, tossing until crisp and golden. Remove and set aside.
Add the remaining oil, the green onion whites, garlic and half the chili and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add the kimchi and cook for 2 minutes, then add the gochujang and rice, tossing and pressing for 4 minutes until hot and lightly crisp.
Stir in the soy sauce and return the tofu. Serve with the sesame oil, sesame seeds, green onion greens and remaining chili.

recipes.title: Bulgogi-style beef rice bowl
recipes.blurb: Sweet, garlicky marinated beef seared hot and piled over rice with crisp lettuce and cucumber.
steps: Mix the soy sauce, sugar, half the sesame oil, garlic, ginger and grated apple in a bowl. Add the beef and marinate for at least 10 minutes while you cook the rice.
Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 1¼ cups of water: boil, cover, reduce to the lowest heat for 12 minutes and rest off the heat.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large frying pan until very hot. Fry the beef in two batches for 2 minutes each, until caramelised at the edges.
Return all the beef with any marinade left in the bowl and bubble for 30 seconds.
Serve over the rice with lettuce leaves and cucumber, scattered with the green onion and sesame seeds and drizzled with the remaining sesame oil.

recipes.title: Thai green chicken curry with green beans
recipes.blurb: Creamy coconut green curry with tender chicken thigh, zucchini and green beans, finished with lime.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 1¼ cups of water: boil, cover, reduce to the lowest heat for 12 minutes and rest off the heat.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the curry paste for 1 minute until fragrant, then add the chicken and stir for 3 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk, fish sauce and sugar, bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 8 minutes.
Add the green beans and zucchini and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Squeeze in the juice of half the lime, taste and adjust. Serve with the rice, cilantro and a wedge of the remaining lime.

recipes.title: Thai red sweet potato and spinach curry
recipes.blurb: Sweet potato and red bell pepper simmered in a fragrant coconut and red curry sauce with wilted spinach.

ingredients.name: Sweet potato
ingredients.prep: peeled and cut into ¾ inch chunks

steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 1¼ cups of water: boil, cover, reduce to the lowest heat for 12 minutes and rest off the heat.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over a medium heat and fry the curry paste for 1 minute.
Add the sweet potato and red bell pepper, stir to coat, then pour in the coconut milk, ½ cup of water, the soy sauce and the sugar.
Simmer gently for 15 to 18 minutes until the sweet potato is soft but holding its shape.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, then squeeze in half the lime juice. Serve with the rice, cilantro and a lime wedge.

recipes.title: Shrimp pad Thai with lime and peanuts
recipes.blurb: Wok-fried rice noodles with jumbo shrimp, egg and bean sprouts in a sweet-sour-salty sauce.
steps: Soak the noodles in just-boiled water for 6 to 8 minutes until pliable but firm, then drain.
Stir the fish sauce, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce and sriracha together in a small bowl until the sugar dissolves.
Heat half the oil in a wok over a high heat and fry the shrimp for 2 minutes until pink, then remove.
Add the remaining oil, garlic and green onion for 20 seconds. Push to one side, crack in the eggs and scramble for 30 seconds.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 2 to 3 minutes until the sauce is absorbed. Return the shrimp, add the bean sprouts and toss for 1 minute.
Serve scattered with the peanuts and a lime wedge to squeeze over.

recipes.title: Thai-style pork with chili, basil and green beans
recipes.blurb: A hot, salty-sweet pork stir-fry with plenty of chili and basil, served over jasmine rice.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 1¼ cups of water: boil, cover, reduce to the lowest heat for 12 minutes and rest off the heat.
Stir the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar and 2 tbsp of water together.
Heat the oil in a wok over a high heat. Add the chili and garlic and stir for 15 seconds, then add the pork, breaking it up, and fry for 5 minutes until browned.
Add the green beans and sauce and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until the beans are just tender and the sauce has reduced.
Take off the heat and stir through most of the basil. Serve over the rice with the remaining basil.

recipes.title: Peanut tofu and rice noodle bowl
recipes.blurb: Crisp tofu and crunchy vegetables with rice noodles in a creamy peanut, lime and chili dressing.

ingredients.name: Firm tofu
ingredients.prep: cut into cubes and patted dry

steps: Soak the noodles in just-boiled water for 6 to 8 minutes until tender, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, juice of the lime, sriracha, ginger, garlic and 4 tbsp of warm water into a smooth dressing.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium-high heat and fry the tofu for 8 minutes, turning, until crisp and golden.
Toss the noodles with the carrot, red bell pepper and most of the dressing.
Divide into bowls and top with the tofu, drizzle with the remaining dressing and scatter over the cilantro and peanuts.

recipes.title: Lemongrass chicken noodle bowl
recipes.blurb: Fragrant lemongrass chicken over cool rice noodles, crunchy veg and herbs with a sharp lime dressing.
steps: Mix the lemongrass, half the garlic, 2 tsp of the fish sauce and 1 tsp of the sugar through the chicken and leave to marinate while you prepare everything else.
Soak the noodles in just-boiled water for 6 to 8 minutes, drain and rinse under cold water.
Make the dressing by stirring the remaining fish sauce, garlic and sugar with the juice of 1.5 limes, the chili and 3 tbsp of water.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over a high heat and fry the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes until caramelised and cooked through.
Divide the noodles into bowls and top with the cucumber, carrot, herbs and chicken. Pour over the dressing and scatter with the peanuts and a wedge of the remaining lime.

recipes.title: Caramel ginger salmon with bok choy
recipes.blurb: Salmon glazed in a sticky caramel, ginger and fish sauce with steamed bok choy and rice.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 1¼ cups of water: boil, cover, reduce to the lowest heat for 12 minutes and rest off the heat.

Melt the sugar with 1 tbsp of water in a small pan over a medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes until amber. Carefully add the fish sauce, 3 tbsp of water, the ginger, garlic and pepper and simmer for 2 minutes.
Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat and sear the salmon for 3 minutes per side.
Pour in the caramel and spoon it over the fish for 1 to 2 minutes until sticky.
Meanwhile steam the bok choy in a covered pan with a splash of water for 3 minutes.
Serve the salmon over the rice with the bok choy, chili, green onion and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.title: Crispy tofu and herb noodle salad
recipes.blurb: Cool rice noodles with golden tofu, mint, cilantro and a sweet-sharp lime and chili dressing.

ingredients.name: Firm tofu
ingredients.prep: cut into cubes and patted dry

steps: Soak the noodles in just-boiled water for 6 to 8 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Stir the soy sauce, sugar, garlic, half the chili and the juice of 1.5 limes with 3 tbsp of water until the sugar dissolves.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium-high heat and fry the tofu for 8 minutes, turning, until crisp on all sides. Toss with 1 tbsp of the dressing.
Toss the noodles with the cucumber, carrot, mint and cilantro.
Divide into bowls, top with the tofu, pour over the remaining dressing and finish with the peanuts, remaining chili and a lime wedge.

recipes.title: Chicken satay with coconut rice and cucumber
recipes.blurb: Peanut-marinated chicken pan-grilled until charred, served with a warm satay sauce and cooling cucumber.
steps: Mix the chicken with half the soy sauce, half the garlic, the ginger and 2 tsp of the peanut butter. Marinate for 10 minutes.
Rinse the rice and cook it in a lidded pan with the coconut milk and ⅔ cup of water: bring to the boil, cover, reduce to the lowest heat for 12 minutes and rest off the heat.
For the sauce, warm the remaining peanut butter, soy sauce, garlic and sweet chili sauce in a small pan with ½ cup of water and the juice of half the lime, stirring until smooth and glossy.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a high heat and fry the chicken for 7 to 8 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Serve the chicken on the rice with the cucumber and cilantro, the sauce spooned over and the remaining lime in wedges.

recipes.title: Vegetable nasi goreng with a fried egg
recipes.blurb: Sweet, smoky and spicy Indonesian fried rice with peas and carrots, topped with a crisp-edged egg.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 1¼ cups of water: boil, cover, reduce to the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then spread on a tray to cool for a few minutes.
Mix the soy sauce, sriracha and sugar with 1 tbsp of water.
Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in a wok over a medium-high heat. Fry the shallots, garlic and chili for 2 minutes, then add the carrot for 2 minutes more.
Add the rice and toss for 3 minutes, then add the peas and sauce and stir-fry for 2 minutes until sticky and hot.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil in a small pan until the whites are crisp and the yolks runny.
Serve the rice topped with the eggs, with the cucumber and green onion on the side.

recipes.title: Gado-gado with crispy tofu and peanut sauce
recipes.blurb: Warm potatoes, green beans, cabbage and bean sprouts under crispy tofu and a thick, lime-bright peanut sauce.

ingredients.name: Firm tofu
ingredients.prep: cut into cubes and patted dry

steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 12 to 14 minutes until tender. Add the green beans for the last 3 minutes, then drain.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium-high heat and fry the tofu for 8 minutes, turning, until crisp and golden.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, sweet chili sauce, garlic, chili, the juice of the lime and ½ cup of warm water until smooth and pourable.
Pour boiling water over the cabbage and bean sprouts in a bowl, leave for 30 seconds, then drain well so they stay crunchy but lose their raw edge.
Arrange the potatoes, beans, cabbage, bean sprouts and cucumber on plates, top with the tofu and pour over the peanut sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken tikka traybake with mint raita
recipes.blurb: Marinated chicken, peppers and red onion roasted until charred, with basmati and a cool cucumber raita.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Stir the tikka paste into ⅓ cup of the yogurt with the juice of half the lemon and a pinch of salt, then coat the chicken in it and leave while the oven heats.
Tip the chicken, pepper and red onion onto a large tray, drizzle with the oil and spread out so nothing is crowded.
Roast for 25 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is cooked through and the edges are blackened in places.
Meanwhile, rinse the rice, cook it in plenty of boiling salted water for 10 minutes, then drain and leave to steam dry with the lid on.
Squeeze the grated cucumber to drain it, then stir into the remaining yogurt with the mint, a squeeze of lemon and some black pepper.
Serve the traybake over the rice with the raita and the remaining lemon cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Fiery lamb keema with peas and green chili
recipes.blurb: Dry-fried spiced ground lamb with sweet peas and a proper chili kick, spooned over basmati.
steps: Put the rice on to cook in boiling salted water for 10 minutes, then drain and keep covered.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over a medium heat and fry the cumin seeds for 30 seconds, then add the onion and cook for 8 minutes until golden at the edges.
Stir in the garlic, ginger and green chili and cook for 1 minute, then add the ground coriander, chili powder and tomato paste.
Turn the heat up, crumble in the lamb and fry for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and the fat has rendered. Add a splash of water and the salt and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the peas and garam masala and cook for 3 minutes until the peas are hot through.
Scatter with cilantro and serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Paneer tikka and pepper traybake with lemon rice
recipes.blurb: Charred, spiced paneer and peppers on a single tray, served over lemony basmati with yogurt.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Mix the tikka paste with half the yogurt and a squeeze of lemon, then fold through the paneer, peppers and onion until coated.
Spread over a large tray, drizzle with the oil and roast for 22 minutes, turning once, until the paneer is golden and the peppers are charred at the edges.
Meanwhile, rinse the rice and cook it in boiling salted water with the turmeric for 10 minutes. Drain, then stir through the zest of the lemon and a pinch of salt.
Loosen the remaining yogurt with a little lemon juice.
Serve the traybake on the lemon rice with the yogurt spooned over and the cilantro scattered on top.

recipes.title: Red lentil tarka dal with rice
recipes.blurb: Soft turmeric lentils finished with a sizzling garlic, cumin and chili tarka.
steps: Rinse the lentils until the water runs mostly clear. Heat half the oil in a saucepan, soften the onion for 6 minutes, then add the grated garlic, ginger and turmeric.
Add the tomatoes, lentils and 2½ cups of water with the salt. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils have collapsed into a thick soup.
While the dal cooks, boil the rice in salted water for 10 minutes, then drain.

For the tarka, heat the remaining oil in a small pan until hot, add the cumin seeds and sliced garlic and fry for about a minute until the garlic is just golden. Take off the heat and stir in the red pepper flakes.
Squeeze a little lemon into the dal and taste for salt. Pour the sizzling tarka over the top, scatter with cilantro and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Aloo gobi with fresh ginger and cilantro
recipes.blurb: Dry-style potato and cauliflower curry with turmeric, cumin and a good hit of green chili.
steps: Heat the oil in a large lidded frying pan, add the cumin seeds for 30 seconds, then the onion, and cook for 7 minutes until soft and lightly golden.
Stir in the garlic, ginger, chili, turmeric and ground coriander and cook for 1 minute.

Add the potato, cauliflower and salt and stir to coat. Pour in the tomatoes and ½ cup of water, cover and cook over a medium-low heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until a knife slides easily into the potato.
Uncover and cook for 3 minutes to thicken any liquid, then stir through the garam masala and a squeeze of lemon.
Warm the naan in a dry pan or under the broiler and serve alongside, topped with the cilantro.

recipes.title: King shrimp coconut curry with lime
recipes.blurb: Juicy shrimp in a silky, gently spiced coconut sauce with ginger, tomato and a squeeze of lime.
steps: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 minutes, drain and keep covered.
Heat the oil in a deep pan and cook the onion over a medium heat for 7 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, ginger and chili and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the turmeric, cumin, cilantro, chili powder and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant, adding a splash of water if it catches.
Pour in the coconut milk, add the salt and simmer gently for 10 minutes until slightly thickened.
Add the shrimp and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, just until pink and curled. Squeeze in the lime juice.
Serve over the rice with the cilantro on top.

recipes.title: Sweet potato and chickpea coconut curry
recipes.blurb: Soft roasted sweet potato and chickpeas in a mellow, creamy curry sauce with a little warmth.

ingredients.name: Sweet potato
ingredients.prep: peeled, cut into ¾ inch cubes

steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the onion for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the curry powder and turmeric for 30 seconds.
Add the sweet potato, chopped tomatoes, coconut milk, salt and ½ cup of water. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook for 15 minutes.
Stir in the chickpeas and simmer uncovered for 8 to 10 minutes until the sweet potato is tender and the sauce coats a spoon.
Meanwhile, cook the rice in boiling salted water for 10 minutes and drain.
Fold the spinach through the curry until wilted, then finish with lime juice to taste. Serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Hot beef madras with basmati
recipes.blurb: Tender strips of beef in a deep red, chili-heavy tomato sauce. Properly hot, balanced with a spoon of yogurt.
steps: Heat half the oil in a heavy pan over a high heat and brown the beef in two batches for 2 minutes each. Set aside.
Lower the heat, add the remaining oil and the onion and cook for 8 minutes until soft and golden. Stir in the garlic, ginger and green chili for 1 minute.
Add the chili powder, red pepper flakes, cumin, cilantro, turmeric and tomato paste and stir for 1 minute, adding a splash of water if it sticks.
Return the beef with any juices, add the chopped tomatoes, salt, sugar and ½ cup of water. Cover and simmer gently for 20 minutes until the beef is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Meanwhile, cook the rice in boiling salted water for 10 minutes and drain.
Serve the madras over the rice with a spoonful of yogurt and the cilantro. Taste before adding more chili, this one is hot.

recipes.title: Tandoori-style salmon with cucumber raita
recipes.blurb: Yogurt-and-spice marinated salmon roasted hot, served with fluffy rice and a cooling raita.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Mix ⅓ cup of the yogurt with the paprika, cumin, garam masala, turmeric, garlic, juice of half the lemon and a pinch of salt. Coat the salmon and leave for 10 minutes.
Boil the rice in salted water for 10 minutes and drain. Cook the green beans in the same pan for the last 4 minutes.
Place the salmon on an oiled tray and roast for 10 to 12 minutes until it flakes easily and the top is spotted with colour.
Stir the cucumber, sliced onion and mint into the remaining yogurt with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt.
Serve the salmon on the rice and beans with the raita and the remaining lemon in wedges.

recipes.title: Vegetable biryani-style rice with cashews
recipes.blurb: Fragrant spiced rice with carrot, peas, golden onion, cashews and a few sweet raisins, all in one pan.
steps: Rinse the rice in cold water until it runs clear, then leave it to drain. Heat half the oil in a wide lidded pan and fry the cashews until golden, about 2 minutes. Lift out and set aside.
Add the remaining oil and the onions and cook over a medium heat for 12 minutes, stirring often, until deep golden. Remove a third for topping.
Add the cumin seeds, bay leaves, garlic, ginger, garam masala, turmeric and cinnamon and stir for 1 minute, then add the carrot and rice and stir to coat.
Dissolve the bouillon cube in 1⅓ cups of boiling water, pour it in with the salt and raisins, bring to the boil, then cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes.
Scatter the peas over the top, replace the lid and leave off the heat for 8 minutes so they steam through.
Fluff with a fork, discard the bay leaves, and top with the reserved onions, cashews, cilantro and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: Mild chicken korma with toasted almonds
recipes.blurb: Gentle, creamy and fragrant, with no heat at all. A korma for anyone who finds a medium curry too much.
steps: Toast the almonds in a dry pan for 2 minutes until pale gold, then tip them out.
Heat the oil in a deep pan and cook the onion for 8 minutes over a gentle heat until completely soft but not coloured. Add the garlic, ginger and spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and stir for 3 minutes to seal, then pour in the coconut milk and ½ cup of water. Season with the salt and sugar and simmer gently for 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, boil the rice in salted water for 10 minutes and drain.
Take the pan off the heat for a minute, then stir in the yogurt and peas and return to a low heat for 2 minutes without boiling.
Serve over the rice, topped with the almonds and cilantro.

recipes.title: Lamb kofta flatbreads with mint yogurt
recipes.blurb: Spiced lamb koftas broiled until sizzling, tucked into warm pita with crunchy salad and mint yogurt.
steps: Heat the broiler to high. In a bowl, mix the lamb with the grated onion, garlic, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, parsley, salt and pepper, and knead for a minute until sticky.
Shape into 8 oval koftas and thread onto skewers or lay on an oiled tray. Broil for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Stir the mint into the yogurt with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt.
Toss the cucumber, tomato and sliced onion with the olive oil and a squeeze of lemon.
Warm the pitas for the last minute under the broiler, then split them and fill with the koftas, salad and a spoonful of mint yogurt.

recipes.title: Chicken shawarma pitas with garlic yogurt
recipes.blurb: Spice-rubbed chicken thighs roasted until crisp at the edges, stuffed in pita with pickled red onion and garlicky yogurt.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the chicken with the cumin, paprika, turmeric, cinnamon, half the garlic, the oil, juice of half the lemon, salt and pepper, and leave for 10 minutes.
Put the sliced onion in a bowl with the vinegar and a pinch of salt and scrunch together. Leave to soften while the chicken cooks.
Spread the chicken on a tray and roast for 18 to 20 minutes, turning once, until cooked through and browned at the edges.
Stir the remaining garlic into the yogurt with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt.
Warm the pitas in the oven for the last 2 minutes, then fill with the chicken, cucumber, tomato, pickled onion, parsley and plenty of garlic yogurt.

recipes.title: Smoky shakshuka with feta and warm pita
recipes.blurb: Eggs baked in a cumin-spiced pepper and tomato sauce, finished with crumbled feta and parsley.
steps: Heat the oil in a deep, lidded frying pan and cook the onion and peppers over a medium heat for 10 minutes until soft and starting to colour.
Add the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika and red pepper flakes and stir for 1 minute, then pour in the tomatoes with the salt and pepper.
Simmer for 8 minutes until the sauce is thick and jammy. Taste and adjust the seasoning.
Make four wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook gently for 5 to 6 minutes until the whites are set but the yolks are still soft.
Warm the pitas in a toaster or dry pan. Crumble the feta over the shakshuka, scatter with parsley and serve straight from the pan with the pita.

recipes.title: Halloumi fattoush with sumac and lemon
recipes.blurb: Crisp pita, cucumber, tomato and mint with golden halloumi and a sharp sumac dressing.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Tear the pitas into rough pieces, toss with 2 tsp of the oil and half the sumac, and bake on a tray for 6 to 8 minutes until crisp.
Whisk the remaining oil with the juice of the lemon, the rest of the sumac, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the cucumber, tomato, romaine heart, radish, red onion, mint and parsley and toss to coat.
Fry the halloumi in a dry non-stick pan over a medium-high heat for 2 minutes per side until deeply golden.
Fold the crisp pita through the salad at the last moment, so it stays crunchy, and top with the hot halloumi.

recipes.title: Crisp chickpea fritters with lemon tahini
recipes.blurb: Herby, cumin-spiced chickpea patties shallow-fried until crisp, with a lemony tahini drizzle and pickled onion.
steps: Scrunch the red onion with the vinegar and a pinch of salt and leave to pickle.

Mash the chickpeas in a bowl, leaving some texture. Mix in the flour, garlic, green onions, cumin, ground coriander, red pepper flakes, parsley, cilantro and salt, and shape into 8 small patties. Chill for 10 minutes if you have time.
Whisk the tahini with the juice of half the lemon, 3 tbsp of cold water and a pinch of salt until smooth and pourable.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat and fry the patties for 3 to 4 minutes per side until deep golden and crisp. Drain on paper towels.
Warm the pitas and serve with the fritters, cucumber, pickled onion, tahini sauce and the remaining lemon in wedges.

recipes.title: Roast eggplant with tahini, bulgur and pomegranate
recipes.blurb: Tender, caramelised eggplant over herby bulgur with a nutty tahini sauce and jewel-like pomegranate.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Place the eggplants cut-side up on a tray, brush generously with 2 tbsp of the oil, sprinkle with the cumin, salt and pepper, and roast for 30 to 35 minutes until deeply golden and completely soft.
Meanwhile, dissolve the bouillon cube in 1 cup of boiling water, pour it over the bulgur in a bowl, cover and leave for 15 minutes until the liquid is absorbed.
Whisk the tahini with the garlic, juice of half the lemon, 2½ tbsp of cold water and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Fluff the bulgur with a fork and stir through the red onion, tomatoes, parsley, mint, the remaining oil and a squeeze of lemon.
Serve the eggplant halves on the bulgur, drizzle with the tahini sauce and scatter with the pomegranate seeds.

recipes.title: Baked beef kofta in spiced tomato sauce
recipes.blurb: Soft cumin-scented beef meatballs simmered in a smoky tomato sauce with pepper, served on buttery rice.
steps: Mix the beef with the grated onion, half the garlic, the cumin, coriander, paprika, cinnamon, half the parsley, half the salt and the pepper. Shape into 12 small ovals.
Heat the oil in a wide ovenproof pan over a medium-high heat and brown the koftas for 4 minutes, turning. Lift out onto a plate.
Add the diced onion and red bell pepper to the pan and cook for 6 minutes. Stir in the remaining garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute, then add the chopped tomatoes and remaining salt.
Nestle the koftas back into the sauce, cover and simmer gently for 12 minutes until cooked through and the sauce is thick.
While they simmer, boil the rice in salted water for 10 minutes and drain.
Spoon the koftas and sauce over the rice and scatter with the remaining parsley.

recipes.title: Lentil and rice mujaddara with crispy onions
recipes.blurb: Comforting cumin-scented lentils and rice topped with deeply browned onions and a cool yogurt and cucumber side.
steps: Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in a wide pan over a medium heat, add the onions with a pinch of salt and cook for 20 minutes, stirring often, until deep brown and crisp at the edges. Lift out half onto a plate.
Add the remaining oil to the pan with the cumin seeds, ground cumin and cinnamon and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the rinsed rice and stir to coat, then pour in 1¼ cups of boiling water mixed with the bouillon cube. Cover and cook on a low heat for 10 minutes.
Stir in the lentils, cover again and cook for 5 minutes more until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed. Season with salt, pepper and a squeeze of lemon.
Mix the yogurt with the cucumber, mint and a pinch of salt.
Serve the rice and lentils topped with the crispy onions and the yogurt alongside.

recipes.title: Chicken tagine with dates and olives
recipes.blurb: Slow-simmered chicken in ginger, cinnamon and saffron-style turmeric with sweet dates and briny olives, over couscous.
steps: Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Heat the oil in a lidded casserole or deep pan over a medium-high heat and brown the chicken for 3 minutes per side, then set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and carrot for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger, cinnamon, turmeric and cumin and stir for 1 minute.
Return the chicken, add the tomatoes and the bouillon cube dissolved in ¾ cup of hot water. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes until the chicken is very tender.
Stir in the dates and olives and cook uncovered for 5 minutes until the sauce is rich and glossy.
Meanwhile, pour ⅔ cup of boiling water over the couscous with a pinch of salt, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork and stir in the lemon zest.
Finish the tagine with lemon juice and cilantro and serve on the couscous with the almonds scattered over.

recipes.title: Harissa jumbo shrimp with lemon couscous
recipes.blurb: Shrimp tossed in rose harissa and seared fast, over lemony herb couscous with roasted peppers.
steps: Toss the shrimp with the harissa, garlic, 2 tsp of the oil and a pinch of salt and leave for 5 minutes.
Put the couscous in a bowl, pour over ⅔ cup of boiling water mixed with the bouillon cube, cover and leave for 5 minutes.
Fluff the couscous with a fork and stir through the roasted peppers, green onions, parsley, mint, the remaining oil, the zest of the lemon and a squeeze of juice.
Heat a large frying pan until very hot and cook the shrimp for 2 to 3 minutes, turning once, until pink and lightly charred.
Pile the couscous onto plates, top with the shrimp and add a spoonful of yogurt loosened with a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: Butternut and chickpea tagine with raisin couscous
recipes.blurb: Gently spiced squash and chickpeas stewed in tomato with raisins, served over fluffy couscous.

ingredients.name: Butternut squash
ingredients.prep: peeled, cut into ¾ inch chunks

steps: Heat the oil in a large lidded pan and cook the onion for 6 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, ras el hanout, cumin and cinnamon and stir for 1 minute.
Add the squash, tomatoes, raisins, bouillon cube dissolved in ⅔ cup of hot water, salt and pepper. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook for 20 minutes.
Stir in the chickpeas and cook uncovered for 8 to 10 minutes until the squash is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Meanwhile, pour ⅔ cup of boiling water over the couscous with a pinch of salt, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Fold the spinach through the tagine until wilted, add lemon juice to taste and stir in most of the cilantro.
Serve over the couscous with the rest of the cilantro on top.

recipes.title: Fiery harissa lamb meatballs
recipes.blurb: Spiced lamb meatballs in a hot harissa and chili tomato sauce, with couscous and a cooling yogurt spoonful.
steps: Mix the lamb with the grated onion, half the garlic, 1 tbsp of the harissa, the cumin, coriander, half the salt and the red pepper flakes. Shape into 12 meatballs.
