Heat the oil in a wide, lidded pan and brown the meatballs for 5 minutes, turning. Take them out and set aside.
In the same pan, cook the diced onion for 5 minutes, then add the remaining garlic, the red chili and the rest of the harissa and stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the passata and ½ cup of water with the remaining salt, add the meatballs back, cover and simmer for 12 minutes until cooked through and the sauce is thick.
Meanwhile, pour ⅔ cup of boiling water over the couscous with a pinch of salt, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff.
Stir the mint and a squeeze of lemon into the yogurt. Serve the meatballs over the couscous with the yogurt alongside to temper the heat.

recipes.title: Ras el hanout cauliflower traybake with herby couscous
recipes.blurb: Whole-roasted cauliflower florets in warm North African spices with chickpeas and lemon couscous.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the cauliflower, chickpeas and red onion on a large tray with 2 tbsp of the oil, the ras el hanout, garlic, salt and pepper.
Roast for 30 minutes, turning once, until the cauliflower is deeply golden and the chickpeas are crisp at the edges.
Meanwhile, pour ⅔ cup of boiling water mixed with the bouillon cube over the couscous, cover and leave for 5 minutes.
Fluff the couscous and stir through the lemon zest, a squeeze of juice, the remaining oil, parsley, mint and cucumber.
Scatter the pumpkin seeds over the traybake for the last 3 minutes to toast, then serve on the couscous.

recipes.title: Sausage and fennel penne
recipes.blurb: Crumbled pork sausage and sweet fennel simmered in tomato, tossed through penne with a little chili.
steps: Heat the oil in a large deep pan over a medium-high heat. Squeeze the sausage meat out of its skins in small nuggets and fry for 6-7 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Add the onion and fennel with a pinch of salt and cook for 8 minutes until soft and lightly golden, then stir in the garlic and red pepper flakes for 30 seconds.
Pour in the chopped tomatoes with half a can of water, season and simmer for 12 minutes until the sauce is thick and glossy.
Meanwhile, cook the penne in well-salted boiling water for 10-11 minutes until just tender. Save a mugful of the cooking water, then drain.
Tip the pasta into the sauce with a splash of the cooking water and toss over the heat for a minute.
Serve topped with the parmesan, parsley and black pepper.

recipes.title: Beef and mushroom ragu rigatoni
recipes.blurb: A slow-feeling beef ragu bulked out with cremini mushrooms and carrot, spooned over big tubes of rigatoni.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan over a high heat and brown the ground beef for 5-6 minutes, breaking it up well. Tip it into a bowl, leaving a spoonful of fat behind.
Lower the heat to medium and cook the onion, carrot and mushrooms for 8-10 minutes until the mushroom moisture has cooked away and everything is soft.
Stir in the garlic, tomato paste and oregano for a minute, then return the beef to the pan.
Add the chopped tomatoes and the bouillon cube crumbled into ⅔ cup of hot water. Season, then simmer gently for 20 minutes until rich and thick.
Boil the rigatoni in well-salted water for 11-12 minutes until tender, saving a splash of cooking water before draining.
Toss the pasta through the ragu, loosening with the reserved water, and serve with the parmesan and plenty of black pepper.

recipes.title: Mushroom, spinach and parmesan risotto
recipes.blurb: Creamy risotto with browned cremini mushrooms, wilted spinach, thyme and a bright squeeze of lemon.
steps: Dissolve the bouillon cubes in 3¼ cups of boiling water and keep it hot in a pan on a low heat.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over a high heat and fry the mushrooms for 6-7 minutes without crowding until deep golden. Season, then scoop them out onto a plate.
Lower the heat, add half the butter and the onion, and cook for 5 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, thyme and rice and stir for 1 minute until the grains turn glossy.
Add the hot stock a ladleful at a time, stirring often and letting each addition mostly absorb before the next. This takes about 18-20 minutes, and the rice should be creamy with a little bite.
Fold in the spinach, mushrooms, remaining butter and most of the parmesan. Add a squeeze of lemon juice and a little zest, then rest the pan off the heat for 2 minutes.
Serve in warm bowls with the last of the parmesan and black pepper.

recipes.title: Tomato and mozzarella gnocchi bake
recipes.blurb: Pillowy gnocchi baked in a basil tomato sauce with blistered cherry tomatoes and bubbling mozzarella.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan) and put a kettle on.
In a medium ovenproof dish, stir together the chopped tomatoes, garlic, oregano, oil, salt, pepper and a splash of water.
Add the gnocchi straight from the packet and the halved cherry tomatoes, turning everything to coat, then bake for 12 minutes.
Stir in the spinach so it wilts into the sauce, scatter over the mozzarella and parmesan, and return to the oven for 8-10 minutes until bubbling and golden in patches.
Rest for 2 minutes, then top with torn basil.

recipes.title: Vegan penne arrabbiata with olives
recipes.blurb: A properly fiery tomato and garlic sauce with fresh chili and briny olives, no cheese needed.
steps: Boil the penne in well-salted water for 10-11 minutes until just tender. Save a mugful of the cooking water, then drain.
While the pasta cooks, warm the oil in a deep frying pan over a medium heat and add the garlic, fresh chili and red pepper flakes. Cook for 1 minute, stirring, until fragrant but not browned.
Pour in the chopped tomatoes, add the sugar and a good pinch of salt, and simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Stir in the olives, then add the pasta with a splash of the cooking water and toss over the heat for 1 minute.
Finish with torn basil and black pepper.

recipes.title: Chili shrimp and cherry tomato linguine
recipes.blurb: Juicy jumbo shrimp, burst cherry tomatoes, lemon and a gentle chili kick through silky linguine.
steps: Cook the linguine in well-salted boiling water for 9-10 minutes until al dente. Save a mugful of cooking water, then drain.
Meanwhile, heat half the oil in a large frying pan over a high heat. Season the shrimp and cook for 1-2 minutes per side until pink, then lift them out.
Lower the heat, add the remaining oil, garlic and chili for 30 seconds, then add the cherry tomatoes with a pinch of salt. Cook for 4-5 minutes, pressing them until they burst.
Add the linguine, a splash of cooking water, the zest of the lemon and a good squeeze of its juice. Toss until the sauce clings.
Return the shrimp to the pan, stir through the parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken, olive and pepper rosemary traybake
recipes.blurb: Chicken thighs roasted over baby potatoes, sweet peppers and olives with rosemary and lemon.

ingredients.name: Garlic clove
ingredients.prep: left in their skins, lightly crushed

steps: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Toss the potatoes with half the oil, half the rosemary and a pinch of salt on a large tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Toss the chicken in the remaining oil and rosemary, with salt and pepper, and cut the lemon in half.
Add the chicken, pepper, red onion, garlic and the lemon halves cut-side down to the tray, turning everything together, and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the olives and cherry tomatoes and roast for 8-10 minutes more, until the chicken is cooked through with no pink and the tomatoes have softened.
Squeeze the roasted lemon over the tray and serve from the tray.

recipes.title: Salmon, caper and lemon linguine
recipes.blurb: Flaked pan-fried salmon and spinach in a light lemony creme fraiche sauce with salty capers.
steps: Cook the linguine in well-salted boiling water for 9-10 minutes until al dente. Save a mugful of the cooking water, then drain.
Meanwhile, season the salmon and fry skin-side down in the oil in a large non-stick pan over a medium-high heat for 4 minutes. Turn and cook for 2-3 minutes more until just cooked through.
Lift the salmon out and flake it into large pieces, discarding the skin if you like. Add the garlic and capers to the pan for 30 seconds.
Stir in the creme fraiche, the lemon zest and juice, and a splash of pasta water, then add the spinach until it just wilts.
Toss in the linguine and flaked salmon gently so it holds its shape, then top with parsley and black pepper.

recipes.title: Tuscan white bean and kale stew
recipes.blurb: Cannellini beans, kale and rosemary in a thick tomato broth, served with olive oil toast.
steps: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large pan over a medium heat. Cook the onion, carrot and celery with a pinch of salt for 8-10 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic and rosemary and cook for 1 minute, then pour in the chopped tomatoes and the bouillon cube dissolved in 1⅔ cups of hot water.
Tip in the cannellini beans, bring to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes. Crush a handful of beans against the side of the pan to thicken the stew.
Stir in the kale and cook for 5 minutes until tender. Season with salt and plenty of pepper.
Toast the sourdough, drizzle with the remaining oil and serve alongside the stew.

recipes.title: Lemon ricotta and zucchini spaghetti
recipes.blurb: Golden zucchini ribbons and creamy lemon ricotta tossed through spaghetti with basil and toasted pine nuts.
steps: Toast the pine nuts in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 2-3 minutes until golden, then tip them out.
Cook the spaghetti in well-salted boiling water for 10 minutes until al dente. Save a mugful of cooking water, then drain.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in the pan over a high heat and fry the zucchini with a pinch of salt for 6-7 minutes until golden at the edges. Add the garlic for the last 30 seconds.
Mix the ricotta with the lemon zest, a squeeze of juice, the parmesan and a splash of the pasta water until loose and creamy.
Toss the spaghetti and zucchini with the ricotta mixture off the heat, loosening with more water if needed. Top with basil, pine nuts and black pepper.

recipes.title: Eggplant and mozzarella tomato bake
recipes.blurb: Roasted eggplant layered with garlicky tomato sauce, melting mozzarella and parmesan, with a peppery side salad.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Toss the eggplant rounds with 1½ tbsp of the oil and half the salt on two trays, then roast for 20 minutes, turning once, until golden and soft.
Meanwhile, soften the onion in 2 tsp oil in a pan for 6 minutes, add the garlic and oregano for 30 seconds, then pour in the passata. Simmer for 10 minutes and season.
Spoon a little sauce into a baking dish, then layer in eggplant, sauce and half the basil, repeating until everything is used.
Top with the mozzarella and parmesan and bake for 12-15 minutes until bubbling and browned.
Dress the leaves with the balsamic and remaining oil, and serve alongside the bake with the last of the basil.

recipes.title: Lemon fennel pork steaks with crushed potatoes
recipes.blurb: Pan-seared pork loin steaks with roasted fennel, thyme and lemony crushed baby potatoes.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Boil the potatoes in salted water for 12 minutes until tender, then drain.
Toss the fennel wedges with half the oil, the thyme and a pinch of salt on a tray and roast for 10 minutes.
Tip the potatoes onto the tray, crush each one lightly with the back of a spoon, drizzle with a little more oil and roast for a further 12-15 minutes.
Rub the pork with the mustard, salt and pepper. Fry in the remaining oil in a hot pan for 3-4 minutes per side until cooked through, adding the garlic for the last minute.
Rest the pork for 3 minutes, then squeeze over a little lemon juice and zest. Stir the parsley into the potatoes and serve everything together.

recipes.title: Greek lemon chicken orzo
recipes.blurb: Chicken and orzo cooked in one pan in a lemony, oregano-scented broth, finished with spinach and feta.
steps: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over a medium-high heat. Season the chicken and brown for 5 minutes, then lift it out onto a plate.
Add the onion to the pan and cook for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic and oregano for 30 seconds.
Stir in the orzo to coat it in the oil, then add the bouillon cube dissolved in 2 cups of boiling water and the zest and juice of the lemon.
Return the chicken, bring to a simmer and cook for 12-14 minutes, stirring now and then, until the orzo is tender and the sauce is creamy.
Fold in the spinach until wilted, then top with the feta, parsley and black pepper.

recipes.title: Lamb kofta pitas with tzatziki
recipes.blurb: Herby cumin-scented lamb patties tucked into warm pitas with tomato, red onion and cool cucumber yogurt.

ingredients.name: Cucumber
ingredients.prep: half grated and squeezed dry, half sliced

steps: Mix the lamb with the grated red onion, garlic, cumin, oregano, parsley, half the mint, half the salt and the pepper. Shape into 8 small oval patties.
Stir the grated cucumber, remaining mint, the rest of the salt and a squeeze of lemon into the yogurt to make a quick tzatziki.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat and cook the kofta for 3-4 minutes per side until browned and cooked through.
Warm the pitas in a toaster or dry pan for 30 seconds on each side.
Stuff the pitas with the kofta, tomato, sliced red onion and sliced cucumber, and finish with plenty of tzatziki and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: Shrimp and feta tomato bake
recipes.blurb: Jumbo shrimp baked in a garlicky oregano tomato sauce under crumbled feta, with ciabatta for mopping.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Warm the oil in an ovenproof frying pan over a medium heat and cook the onion for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, oregano and red pepper flakes for 30 seconds, then pour in the chopped tomatoes. Season and simmer for 8 minutes until thick.
Stir the shrimp into the sauce, scatter the feta over the top and bake for 8-10 minutes until the shrimp are pink and the feta is lightly golden.
Warm the ciabatta in the oven for the final 3 minutes.
Scatter with parsley and serve straight from the pan with the ciabatta for mopping.

recipes.title: Grilled halloumi Greek salad with pitas
recipes.blurb: Golden halloumi slices over crunchy tomato, cucumber, olive and romaine heart salad with warm oregano pita.
steps: Soak the sliced red onion in the vinegar with a pinch of salt for 10 minutes to soften its bite.
Combine the tomatoes, cucumber, romaine heart and olives in a large bowl and tip in the onion with its vinegar. Dress with 1 tbsp of the oil, a squeeze of lemon and the pepper.
Heat a dry non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat and cook the halloumi for 1-2 minutes per side until deeply golden.
Rub the pitas with the remaining oil and the oregano, then toast them for about 30 seconds on each side in the same pan or a toaster.
Pile the halloumi over the salad and serve with the warm pitas.

recipes.title: Greek butter bean and tomato bake
recipes.blurb: Big butter beans slow-baked in sweet oregano tomato sauce with spinach, finished with parsley and crusty toast.
steps: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Warm 1 tbsp of the oil in an ovenproof pan over a medium heat and cook the onion for 8 minutes until soft and sweet.
Add the garlic, oregano and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then add the chopped tomatoes, sugar, salt and pepper with ½ cup of water.
Stir in the butter beans and spinach, bring to a simmer, then bake for 20 minutes until the sauce is thick and the beans are jammy.
Toast the sourdough and drizzle with the remaining oil.
Top the beans with parsley and serve with the toast.

recipes.title: Spinach and feta puff pastry pie
recipes.blurb: A folded golden pastry parcel of wilted spinach, tangy feta, green onion and dill with a crisp leafy side.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Warm half the oil in a large pan, add the green onions for 1 minute, then add the spinach in handfuls until wilted, about 3 minutes.
Tip the spinach into a sieve and press out as much water as you can, then chop it roughly into a bowl.
Beat one egg and stir half of it into the spinach with the feta, dill, lemon zest, salt and pepper.
Unroll the pastry on its paper onto a baking tray. Spread the filling over one half, leaving a ¾ inch edge, then fold the other half over and press the edges with a fork to seal.
Beat the second egg with the rest of the first and brush all over the pastry, cut two slits in the top, then bake for 22-25 minutes until puffed and deep golden.
Dress the leaves with the remaining oil and a squeeze of lemon, and serve with slices of the pie.

recipes.title: Chorizo and butter bean stew
recipes.blurb: Smoky chorizo, red bell pepper and butter beans in a paprika tomato sauce, finished with spinach and toasted sourdough.
steps: Fry the chorizo in a large pan over a medium heat for 4-5 minutes until it releases its red oil and the edges crisp. Lift out half and set aside for topping.
Add the onion and pepper to the pan and cook for 8 minutes until soft, then stir in the garlic and smoked paprika for 1 minute.
Pour in the chopped tomatoes and ½ cup of water, add the beans, and simmer for 12-15 minutes until thick. Mash a few beans into the sauce to give it body.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts and season with salt and pepper.
Toast the sourdough with the oil, then serve the stew topped with the reserved chorizo, the parsley and the toast.

recipes.title: Garlic chili shrimp with smoky tomatoes
recipes.blurb: Sizzling garlic and chili shrimp with blistered tomatoes, smoked paprika and a baguette for the oil.
steps: Warm the baguette slices in the oven at 180C (160C fan) for 5 minutes while you cook.
Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a frying pan over a high heat and cook the cherry tomatoes with a pinch of salt for 3-4 minutes until blistered, then tip them into a bowl.
Lower the heat to medium, add the remaining oil, the garlic, fresh chili and red pepper flakes and sizzle for 1 minute until fragrant but not brown.
Add the shrimp and smoked paprika and cook for 2-3 minutes, turning once, until pink and curled.
Return the tomatoes to the pan with a squeeze of lemon and the parsley, and toss.
Serve with the arugula and the warm baguette to mop up the garlicky oil.

recipes.title: Smoky chickpeas and spinach on toast
recipes.blurb: Garlicky smoked-paprika chickpeas wilted with spinach and tomatoes, piled onto olive oil sourdough.
steps: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat and cook the onion with a pinch of salt for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, smoked paprika, cumin and red pepper flakes and stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chickpeas and cherry tomatoes with ½ cup of water and cook for 8 minutes, pressing a few chickpeas and tomatoes with a spoon until the sauce thickens.
Stir in the spinach and vinegar and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Taste and season.
Toast the sourdough and drizzle with the remaining oil, then pile the chickpeas on top.

recipes.title: Patatas bravas with fried eggs and garlic yogurt
recipes.blurb: Crisp roasted potatoes under spicy smoky tomato sauce, topped with runny eggs, garlic yogurt and wilted spinach.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Toss the potatoes with 1½ tbsp of the oil and half the salt on a large tray and roast for 30-35 minutes, turning twice, until crisp and golden.

Meanwhile, warm 2 tsp oil in a pan, add two of the garlic cloves, the smoked paprika and red pepper flakes for 30 seconds, then add the chopped tomatoes, vinegar and a pinch of salt. Simmer for 15 minutes until thick, then blend or mash until fairly smooth.
Stir the remaining garlic into the yogurt with a squeeze of lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Wilt the spinach in a hot dry pan for 1-2 minutes, then set aside.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil over a medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes until the whites are set and the edges are crisp.
Pile the potatoes onto plates with the spinach, spoon over the bravas sauce, top with an egg and a dollop of garlic yogurt, and finish with parsley.

recipes.title: Chicken and chorizo smoky rice
recipes.blurb: A paella-style one-pan rice with chicken thighs, chorizo, red bell pepper and peas, scented with smoked paprika.
steps: Heat the oil in a wide, deep pan over a medium-high heat. Season the chicken and brown it with the chorizo for 6-7 minutes until the chorizo has released its oil.
Add the onion and red bell pepper and cook for 6 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic, smoked paprika, turmeric and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Stir in the rice to coat it, then pour in the bouillon cube dissolved in 2 cups of boiling water. Bring to a simmer, then do not stir again.
Cook gently, uncovered, for 15 minutes until most of the liquid has absorbed, scattering the peas over in the last 3 minutes.
Take off the heat, cover with a lid or foil and rest for 5 minutes. Serve with the parsley and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Vegetable paella with peppers and green beans
recipes.blurb: Saffron-hued smoky rice with red bell pepper, zucchini, green beans and peas, finished with lemon and parsley.
steps: Dissolve the bouillon cubes in 2 cups of boiling water and keep it hot.
Heat the oil in a wide, deep pan over a medium heat and cook the onion, pepper and zucchini for 8 minutes until softened and lightly golden.
Stir in the garlic, smoked paprika, turmeric and tomato paste for 1 minute, then add the rice and stir until coated.
Pour in the hot stock, add the green beans, season and bring to a simmer. Cook uncovered for 15 minutes without stirring, until the rice is nearly tender.
Scatter the peas over the top and cook for 3 minutes more, then rest off the heat, covered, for 5 minutes.
Serve with the parsley and wedges of lemon to squeeze over.

recipes.title: Chicken and avocado wraps with lime yogurt
recipes.blurb: Seared chicken, creamy avocado and crunchy romaine heart rolled up with a zesty lime yogurt.
steps: Toss the chicken strips with the cumin, a tablespoon of the oil and a good pinch of salt and pepper.
Heat a frying pan over a medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6-7 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked through. Rest for 2 minutes.
Stir the finely grated zest of the lime and a squeeze of juice into the yogurt, add the green onions and season.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 15 seconds each side.
Spread each wrap with lime yogurt, top with lettuce, avocado and chicken, then roll up tightly and halve to serve.

recipes.title: Tuna, corn and cheddar toastie
recipes.blurb: A golden, gooey toastie packed with green onion tuna mayo and a handful of corn.
steps: Mash the tuna with the mayonnaise, green onions, half the corn and plenty of black pepper.
Butter one side of each slice of bread. Turn two slices butter-side down and spread with the tuna mixture.
Scatter over the remaining corn and the cheddar, then top with the other slices, butter-side up.
Cook in a medium frying pan for 3-4 minutes per side, pressing down gently, until deep golden and the cheese has melted.
Rest for a minute, then cut in half and serve.

recipes.title: Smoked salmon and cucumber rice bowl
recipes.blurb: Warm jasmine rice with silky smoked salmon, avocado and a sharp soy and rice vinegar dressing.
steps: Rinse the rice, then simmer in plenty of water for 11-12 minutes until tender. Drain well and leave to steam dry for 2 minutes.
Whisk the soy sauce, rice vinegar and sesame oil in a small bowl.
Toss the cucumber with a spoonful of the dressing and let it sit for 5 minutes to soften slightly.
Divide the rice between two bowls and top with the cucumber, avocado and torn smoked salmon.
Drizzle over the remaining dressing and finish with green onion and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Ham, cheddar and apple sourdough toastie
recipes.blurb: Salty ham, sharp cheddar and crisp apple with a dab of mustard between golden sourdough.
steps: Spread the mustard over two slices of sourdough and butter the outside of all four slices.
Layer the ham, apple slices and cheddar on the mustard slices and season with black pepper.
Close with the remaining bread, butter-side out.
Cook in a frying pan over a medium heat for 3-4 minutes each side, pressing down, until the bread is crisp and the cheese has melted.
Slice diagonally and eat while hot.

recipes.title: Halloumi couscous bowl with mint and lemon
recipes.blurb: Golden halloumi over lemony couscous with cherry tomatoes, cucumber and plenty of mint.
steps: Crumble the bouillon cube into a bowl, add ¾ cup boiling water, then stir in the couscous. Cover and leave for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Dress the couscous with half the oil, the zest of the lemon and a good squeeze of juice.
Heat a non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat and fry the halloumi for 2 minutes each side until deeply golden.
Fold the tomatoes, cucumber and most of the mint through the couscous.
Pile into bowls, top with the halloumi and finish with the remaining mint and black pepper.

recipes.title: Spinach, feta and pepper frittata slices
recipes.blurb: A thick baked-then-broiled frittata that slices cleanly and keeps well for lunchboxes.
steps: Heat the broiler to high. Heat the oil in a small ovenproof frying pan and soften the pepper and green onions for 4 minutes.
Add the spinach and stir until just wilted, about 1 minute.
Beat the eggs with the salt and pepper, then pour into the pan. Scatter over the feta.
Cook on a medium-low heat for 5 minutes until the edges are set but the top is still slightly wet.
Broil for 3-4 minutes until puffed and golden. Cool for 5 minutes, then cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Peanut tofu and rice noodle salad
recipes.blurb: Crispy tofu, crunchy veg and slippery noodles tossed in a lime and peanut dressing.
steps: Soak the noodles in just-boiled water for 6-8 minutes until soft, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the tofu for 8-10 minutes, turning, until crisp on most sides.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, sweet chili, the juice of the lime and 2 tablespoons of warm water until smooth.
Toss the noodles, cucumber, carrot and cilantro with the dressing.
Divide between bowls, top with the tofu and scatter over the peanuts.

recipes.title: Miso tofu udon soup with bok choy
recipes.blurb: A quick, gently savoury broth with chewy udon, soft tofu and fresh ginger.
steps: Bring 3 cups water to a simmer with the ginger. Add the bok choy and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the udon and cook for 2-3 minutes, separating the strands with a fork, until hot through.
Turn the heat down low. Whisk the miso with a ladle of the hot broth until smooth, then stir it back into the pan along with the soy sauce.
Slide in the tofu and warm for 1 minute without boiling.
Ladle into bowls and finish with the green onions and a few drops of sesame oil.

recipes.title: Black bean and corn rice bowl with avocado
recipes.blurb: Cumin-spiced beans and corn over fluffy rice with cool avocado, lime and cilantro.
steps: Rinse the rice and cook in boiling salted water for 10-12 minutes until tender. Drain and keep covered.
Warm the oil in a pan and add the cumin and red pepper flakes for 20 seconds.
Tip in the beans and corn with a splash of water and cook for 5 minutes, mashing a few beans, until hot and glossy.
Toss the tomatoes and cilantro with the juice of half the lime and a pinch of salt.
Spoon the rice into bowls, top with the beans, tomato salsa and avocado, and serve with the remaining lime cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Smoky red lentil and tomato soup
recipes.blurb: A thick, warming soup of red lentils, carrot and tomato with cumin and smoked paprika.
steps: Heat the oil in a saucepan and soften the onion and carrot over a medium heat for 6 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, cumin and smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, chopped tomatoes, the bouillon cube and 2 cups water. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 18-20 minutes until the lentils collapse.
Blitz with a stick blender until mostly smooth, loosening with water if needed.
Season with salt, pepper and a squeeze of lemon juice before serving.

recipes.title: Curried chicken and raisin pitas
recipes.blurb: Mild curry-spiced chicken in cool yogurt with sweet raisins, stuffed into warm pita.
steps: Toss the chicken with half the curry powder and the oil. Fry in a hot pan for 7-8 minutes until golden and cooked through, then cool for 5 minutes.
Stir the remaining curry powder, the raisins, mint and a squeeze of lemon into the yogurt.
Fold the chicken through the yogurt dressing and season with salt.
Warm the pitas under the broiler for 1 minute and split them open.
Fill with lettuce and the curried chicken.

recipes.title: Greek salad feta pita pockets
recipes.blurb: Crunchy cucumber, tomato and olives with feta, stuffed into warm pita with oregano.
steps: Whisk the oil, vinegar, oregano and black pepper in a bowl.
Add the cucumber, tomato, onion and olives and toss to coat.
Fold through the feta gently so it stays in chunks.
Warm the pitas for 30 seconds in a toaster or dry pan, then split along one edge.
Stuff each pocket with the salad and spoon over any dressing left in the bowl.

recipes.title: Caprese ciabattas with pesto and arugula
recipes.blurb: Fresh mozzarella, ripe tomato and peppery arugula piled into soft ciabatta with green pesto.
steps: Split the ciabatta rolls and toast the cut sides for 1-2 minutes if you like them crisp.
Spread the pesto over both halves of each roll.
Layer the tomato and mozzarella on the bases and season well with salt and pepper.
Toss the arugula with the oil and balsamic vinegar and pile on top.
Press the lids on and cut in half to serve.

recipes.title: Quinoa, beets and goats' cheese bowl
recipes.blurb: Earthy beets and nutty quinoa with creamy goats' cheese, walnuts and a balsamic dressing.
steps: Rinse the quinoa and simmer in 1¼ cups salted water for 12-15 minutes until the water is absorbed. Fluff and leave to cool slightly.
Whisk the oil, balsamic, mustard, salt and pepper into a dressing.
Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Toss the quinoa with half the dressing, the beets and the arugula.
Divide between bowls and top with the goats' cheese, walnuts and the remaining dressing.

recipes.title: Black bean and cheddar pepper quesadillas
recipes.blurb: Crisp, cheesy wraps filled with mashed black beans, sweet pepper and green onion.
steps: Roughly mash the beans with the smoked paprika, leaving some texture.
Mix in the pepper and green onions.
Spread the bean mixture over two tortillas, scatter over the cheddar and top with the other tortillas.
Brush a frying pan with a little oil and cook each quesadilla for 3 minutes per side over a medium heat until crisp and the cheese oozes.
Stir a squeeze of lime into the yogurt, cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve with the dip.

recipes.title: Shrimp and lime rice noodle salad
recipes.blurb: Zingy noodle salad with juicy shrimp, crunchy veg, mint and a fish sauce and lime dressing.
steps: Soak the noodles in just-boiled water for 6-8 minutes until tender, then drain and rinse in cold water.
Whisk the lime juice, fish sauce and sweet chili sauce with a tablespoon of water.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and cook the shrimp for 3-4 minutes, turning, until pink and curled. Cool for 3 minutes.
Toss the noodles with the cucumber, carrot, herbs and dressing.
Top with the shrimp and scatter over the peanuts.

recipes.title: Egg mayo and chive sandwiches with arugula
recipes.blurb: Soft-boiled-then-hard egg mayo with chives and mustard, piled high with peppery arugula.
steps: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook for 9 minutes, then cool in cold water for 3 minutes and peel.
Mash the eggs with the mayonnaise, mustard, chives, salt and plenty of black pepper.
Toast the bread if you like it crisp.
Spread the egg mayo over two slices, top with the arugula and close with the remaining slices.
Cut in half and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken and parmesan Caesar-style wraps
recipes.blurb: Lemony chicken, crisp romaine heart and shaved parmesan in a garlicky Caesar-style dressing.
steps: Season the chicken with black pepper and fry in the oil over a medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Mix the mayonnaise, mustard, garlic, half the parmesan, the zest of the lemon and a squeeze of juice into a dressing.
Toss the chicken with half the dressing.
Warm the tortillas briefly in a dry pan.
Fill with lettuce and chicken, drizzle over the remaining dressing, sprinkle with parmesan and roll up.

recipes.title: Puy lentil, roasted pepper and spinach salad
recipes.blurb: A no-cook lunchbox salad of earthy lentils, sweet jarred peppers and baby spinach.
steps: Whisk the oil, vinegar, smoked paprika, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the red onion and leave for 3 minutes to mellow.
Tip in the lentils and roasted peppers and toss well.
Fold through the spinach and parsley just before serving so the leaves stay fresh.
Spoon into bowls or lunchboxes.

recipes.title: Kimchi egg fried rice
recipes.blurb: Tangy, punchy kimchi fried rice topped with a crispy-edged fried egg and green onion.
steps: Cook the rice in boiling water for 11-12 minutes, drain and spread on a plate to cool for 5 minutes.
Heat half the vegetable oil in a wok over a high heat and stir-fry the kimchi and white green onion for 2 minutes.
Add the rice, gochujang and soy sauce and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until hot and lightly crisp.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil in a separate pan until the whites are crisp at the edges.
Divide the rice between bowls, top with the eggs, drizzle with sesame oil and finish with sesame seeds and green green onion.

recipes.title: Feta shakshuka skillet
recipes.blurb: Eggs baked in a smoky pepper and tomato sauce with crumbled feta and fresh cilantro.
steps: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan and cook the onion and pepper over a medium heat for 8 minutes until soft.
Stir in the garlic, paprika and cumin for 1 minute, then add the tomatoes and salt.
Simmer for 8 minutes until thick and jammy.
Make four wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs. Cover and cook gently for 4-5 minutes until the whites are set.
Scatter over the feta and cilantro and serve straight from the pan.

recipes.title: Smoked salmon bagels with chive cream cheese
recipes.blurb: Toasted bagels with lemony chive soft cheese, ribboned smoked salmon and cucumber.
steps: Split and toast the bagels until golden.
Beat the soft cheese with the chives, a squeeze of lemon and black pepper.
Spread the cheese generously over all four halves.
Top with cucumber and folds of smoked salmon.
Add a final squeeze of lemon and close up or eat open.

recipes.title: Chorizo, egg and cheddar breakfast burritos
recipes.blurb: Soft scrambled eggs, crisp chorizo and melted cheddar rolled into warm tortillas.
steps: Fry the chorizo in a dry non-stick pan over a medium heat for 4 minutes until it releases its oil and crisps.
Add the pepper and green onions and cook for 2 minutes.
Beat the eggs with black pepper, add the butter to the pan and pour in the eggs. Stir gently for 2 minutes until softly scrambled.
Warm the tortillas, scatter with cheddar and spoon over the eggs.
Add the cilantro, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.

recipes.title: Blueberry yogurt pancakes
recipes.blurb: Fluffy, tangy pancakes dotted with blueberries and served with yogurt and maple syrup.
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, milk and egg yolks into a smooth batter, then stir in half the yogurt.
Whisk the egg whites to soft peaks and fold gently into the batter for extra lift.
Melt a little butter in a large non-stick pan over a medium heat and spoon in small rounds of batter.
Scatter a few blueberries onto each and cook for 2 minutes until bubbles appear. Flip and cook for 1-2 minutes more.
Stack the pancakes and top with the remaining yogurt, blueberries and a drizzle of maple syrup.

recipes.title: Berry granola yogurt pots
recipes.blurb: Layers of thick yogurt, crunchy granola and fresh berries with a drizzle of honey.
steps: Spoon a layer of yogurt into the base of two jars or glasses.
Add a layer of granola, then half the berries.
Repeat the layers with the remaining yogurt, granola and berries.
Drizzle over the honey.
Eat straight away for crunch, or chill for up to a day for a softer pot.

recipes.title: Mango berry banana smoothie bowl
recipes.blurb: A thick, icy oat milk smoothie bowl with mango and berries, topped with granola and seeds.
steps: Blend the banana, most of the mango, the frozen berries and the oat drink until thick and smooth, scraping down the sides.
Add a splash more oat drink only if it will not blend.
Spoon into two bowls.
Top with granola, pumpkin seeds, blueberries and the remaining mango.
Eat immediately.

recipes.title: Apple cinnamon bircher with walnuts
recipes.blurb: Overnight oats soaked in milk and yogurt with grated apple, cinnamon, raisins and walnuts.
steps: Stir the oats, grated apple, yogurt, milk, cinnamon and raisins together in a bowl.
Cover and chill overnight, or for at least 4 hours; the whole step takes about 10 minutes of hands-on time.
Loosen with a splash of milk if the oats have thickened too much.
Spoon into bowls.
Top with the walnuts and a pinch more cinnamon.

recipes.title: Smashed avocado, feta and egg sourdough
recipes.blurb: Chili-flecked smashed avocado and feta on crisp sourdough, topped with a soft egg.
steps: Toast the sourdough until crisp and golden.
Mash the avocado with the juice of the lemon half, the oil, half the feta and black pepper, keeping it chunky.
Bring a pan of water to a gentle simmer and poach the eggs for 3 minutes for a runny yolk.
Spread the avocado over the toast.
Top each slice with an egg, the remaining feta and a pinch of red pepper flakes.

recipes.title: Garlic mushroom and spinach sourdough toast
recipes.blurb: Golden garlicky mushrooms and wilted spinach on thick crisp sourdough with lemon and parsley.
steps: Heat half the oil in a wide pan over a high heat and fry the mushrooms for 6-7 minutes until deeply browned, without moving them too much.
Add the remaining oil and the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the spinach until just wilted, then season with salt, pepper and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Toast the sourdough until crisp.
Pile the mushrooms onto the toast and scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Spinach, mushroom and cheddar omelette
recipes.blurb: A soft, fluffy omelette folded around buttery mushrooms, wilted spinach and melting cheddar.
steps: Melt half the butter in a non-stick pan and fry the mushrooms for 5 minutes until golden. Add the spinach until wilted, then tip out and keep warm.
Beat the eggs with the salt and pepper.
Wipe the pan, melt a quarter of the remaining butter and pour in half the eggs, stirring gently, then leave for 1 minute until almost set.
Add half the filling and cheddar to one side, fold over the other side and slide onto a plate.
Repeat for the second omelette and finish both with chives.

recipes.title: Lardon and fried egg muffin melts
recipes.blurb: Toasted English muffins with crisp smoked lardons, a fried egg and melted cheddar.
steps: Fry the lardons in a dry pan over a medium heat for 5-6 minutes until crisp, then lift out onto paper towels.
Split and toast the muffins.
Add the butter to the pan and fry the eggs for 2-3 minutes until the whites are set.
Spread ketchup on the muffin bases, scatter with lardons and cheddar, then top with the eggs and black pepper.
Broil for 1 minute until the cheese melts, then close with the muffin tops.

recipes.title: Sweet potato and black bean breakfast hash
recipes.blurb: Crisp smoky sweet potato with black beans and peppers, topped with avocado and lime.
steps: Heat the oil in a large frying pan and cook the sweet potato over a medium heat for 12 minutes, turning occasionally, until tender and crisp at the edges.
Add the onion, pepper and smoked paprika and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the black beans and salt and cook for 3 minutes until hot.
Squeeze over half the lime and stir through half the cilantro.
Spoon into bowls and top with avocado, the remaining cilantro and wedges of lime.

recipes.title: Peanut butter banana and seed toast
recipes.blurb: Thick toast spread with peanut butter and topped with banana, pumpkin seeds, cinnamon and maple.
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Spread each slice generously with peanut butter while still warm.
Arrange the banana slices over the top.
Scatter over the pumpkin seeds and dust with cinnamon.
Finish with a thin drizzle of maple syrup.

recipes.title: Smoky baked bean and egg skillet
recipes.blurb: Baked beans simmered with smoked paprika and baked-in eggs, served with buttered toast.
steps: Warm the oil in a small frying pan and cook the green onions for 1 minute.
Add the smoked paprika and red pepper flakes, then tip in the baked beans and simmer for 3 minutes.
Make two wells in the beans and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook gently for 4-5 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks still soft.
Toast and butter the bread and serve alongside with black pepper over the top.

recipes.title: Tomato & garlic spaghetti
recipes.blurb: Spaghetti in a slow-simmered tomato sauce with plenty of garlic and black pepper.
steps: Bring a large pan of well-salted water to the boil for the spaghetti.
Warm the olive oil in a saucepan over a low heat. Add the garlic and stir for about a minute, without letting it colour.
Stir in the tomato paste, then the chopped tomatoes, sugar and black pepper. Simmer gently for 12 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick and glossy.
Cook the spaghetti for the time on the packet, then drain, keeping a mugful of the water.
Toss the spaghetti through the sauce, loosening with a splash of pasta water if needed. Taste, adjust the salt and serve straight away.

recipes.title: Lentil & tomato stew
recipes.blurb: A thick, cumin-warmed stew of red lentils, carrot and tomatoes that needs very little attention.
steps: Warm the oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Cook the onion and carrot for 8 minutes, stirring, until the onion is soft.
Add the garlic and cumin and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.

Rinse the lentils and add them with the tomatoes, the bouillon cube crumbled in and 2 cups of water. Bring to the boil, then simmer gently for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender and the stew is thick.
Add a splash more water if it catches or gets too thick. Season with salt and pepper and serve in bowls.

recipes.title: Chickpea & spinach curry
recipes.blurb: A quick, mild curry of chickpeas in a turmeric and cumin tomato sauce, finished with wilted spinach.
steps: Put the rice on to cook following the packet, with a good pinch of salt in the water.
Warm the oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Cook the onion for 7 minutes, stirring, until soft, then add the garlic, cumin and turmeric and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and ½ cup of water and simmer gently for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the chickpeas and simmer for 5 minutes until hot through. Add the spinach a handful at a time, stirring until wilted.
Season to taste and serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Pepper & bean rice
recipes.blurb: Red bell pepper and kidney beans simmered in tomato and stirred through fluffy rice.
steps: Put the rice in a saucepan with 1¼ cups of water and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, cover, reduce to a low simmer and cook for 12 minutes until the water is absorbed. Take off the heat and keep covered.
Meanwhile, warm the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Cook the onion and pepper for 8 minutes, stirring, until soft.
Add the tomatoes and kidney beans, season, and simmer for 8 minutes until thick and hot through.
Fluff the rice with a fork, stir it through the beans and vegetables, and serve.

recipes.title: Mushroom & pea couscous
recipes.blurb: Golden mushrooms, sweet peas and soft onion tossed through fluffy couscous.
steps: Crumble the bouillon cube into a heatproof bowl, add the couscous and pour over ¾ cup of boiling water. Cover and leave for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Warm the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Cook the onion for 4 minutes, then add the mushrooms and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring, until golden and the liquid has evaporated.
Add the peas and cook for 3 minutes until hot through.
Stir in the couscous, a squeeze of lemon juice, the parsley and plenty of seasoning, and serve.

recipes.title: Roast vegetables & chickpeas
recipes.blurb: A single-tray supper of cumin-roasted carrot, zucchini, pepper and crisp chickpeas.

ingredients.name: Red bell pepper
ingredients.prep: deseeded and cut into ¾ inch pieces

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Put the carrot on a large tray first, as it takes longest.

Roast the carrot for 10 minutes, then add the zucchini, pepper, onion and chickpeas to the tray. Toss with the oil, cumin, salt and pepper, spreading everything out in one layer (use two trays if crowded).
Roast for 25 minutes more, turning once halfway, until the vegetables are tender and the chickpeas are crisp at the edges.
Squeeze over the lemon juice and serve straight from the tray.

recipes.title: Potato & vegetable frittata
recipes.blurb: A thick, set omelette of soft potato, red bell pepper and onion, cooked gently in one pan.

ingredients.name: White potatoes
ingredients.prep: peeled and cut into ⅓ inch pieces

steps: Put the potato in a small pan of salted water, bring to a simmer and cook for 8 to 10 minutes until just tender. Drain well.
Warm the oil in a 9½ inches non-stick frying pan with a lid over a medium heat. Cook the onion and pepper for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the potato to the pan. Beat the eggs with salt and pepper and pour them evenly over the vegetables.
Reduce to a gentle heat, cover and cook for 8 to 12 minutes until the egg is set all the way through, with no runny egg in the middle.
Slide the frittata onto a board, cut into wedges and serve warm.

recipes.title: Warm apple oats
recipes.blurb: Creamy stovetop oatmeal with soft diced apple and a little cinnamon.
steps: Put the oats, milk, diced apple and cinnamon into a saucepan.
Heat gently, stirring, until it reaches a simmer. Cook over a low heat for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring often so it does not catch, until the oats and apple are soft.
Spoon into bowls and let cool for a minute before eating.

recipes.title: Yogurt, banana & oats
recipes.blurb: A no-cook bowl of thick yogurt, rolled oats and sliced banana.
steps: Divide the yogurt between two bowls.
Stir the oats into the yogurt and leave for 2 minutes to soften slightly.
Fold the sliced banana through, drizzle with the honey, dust with cinnamon and eat straight away.

recipes.title: Tomato & egg toast
recipes.blurb: Soft scrambled eggs cooked with softened fresh tomato, piled onto toast.
steps: Beat the eggs in a bowl with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Warm the oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Add the tomatoes and cook for 4 minutes until softened.
Reduce the heat, pour in the eggs and stir gently with a spatula until set but still soft and creamy.
Toast the bread while the eggs cook, then top with the tomato and egg.

recipes.title: Chickpea & cucumber salad
recipes.blurb: A fresh, no-cook salad of chickpeas, cucumber and tomato dressed with lemon and olive oil.
steps: Put the chickpeas, cucumber and tomatoes in a bowl.
Squeeze in the juice of the lemon, add the olive oil, salt and pepper, and toss well.
Leave for 5 minutes so the flavours mingle, then serve.

recipes.title: White bean & tomato toast
recipes.blurb: Cannellini beans in a simple tomato sauce, spooned over crisp toast.
steps: Put the oil, tomatoes and pepper in a saucepan and simmer gently for 8 minutes, stirring, until slightly thickened.
Add the beans and heat for 4 to 5 minutes until hot through. Season with salt.
Toast the bread, spoon over the beans and tomato, and serve.

recipes.title: Hummus & carrot pita
recipes.blurb: Homemade lemony hummus stuffed into warm pita with grated carrot and cucumber.
steps: Blitz the chickpeas, tahini, juice of the lemon, garlic, olive oil, salt and 3 to 4 tablespoons of cold water in a food processor until smooth, adding more water if too thick.
Warm the pitas briefly in a toaster or dry pan, then split each to make a pocket.
Spread the hummus inside, then fill with grated carrot and cucumber and serve.

recipes.title: Bean & corn chili
recipes.blurb: A smoky, medium-spicy veg chili of kidney and black beans with corn, served over rice.
steps: Warm the oil in a large pan over a medium heat. Cook the onion and pepper for 8 minutes until soft, then add the garlic, paprika, cumin, chili powder and tomato paste and stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and ⅔ cup of water, then the kidney beans, black beans and half the corn. Bring to a simmer and cook gently for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick.
Meanwhile, cook the rice following the packet instructions.
Stir in the remaining corn, season, and heat for 2 minutes. Serve over the rice with the cilantro scattered on top.

recipes.title: Chili baked potatoes
recipes.blurb: Crisp-skinned baked potatoes piled with smoky bean chili and melting cheddar.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Prick the potatoes, rub with 2 tsp of the oil and a pinch of salt, and bake directly on the shelf for 55 to 60 minutes until the skins are crisp and the middles soft.
About 25 minutes before the end, warm the remaining oil in a saucepan and cook the onion for 7 minutes. Add the garlic and spices and stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and beans with ½ cup of water, season, and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Split the potatoes, spoon in the chili, top with the cheddar and green onions, and serve.

recipes.title: Chili bean wraps
recipes.blurb: Warm tortillas filled with a quick smoky kidney bean and corn chili.
steps: Warm the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the paprika, cumin and chili powder for 30 seconds, then add the passata, beans and corn. Simmer for 8 minutes, mashing a few beans against the pan to thicken, and season.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or microwave for 20 to 30 seconds.
Spoon the chili down the middle of each tortilla, fold in the sides and serve.

recipes.title: Garlic & chili spaghetti
recipes.blurb: Aglio e olio style: spaghetti in garlicky chili oil with parsley and lemon, ready in 20 minutes.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in a large pan of well-salted boiling water for the time on the packet. Before draining, scoop out a mugful of the cooking water.

While the pasta cooks, warm the olive oil in a large frying pan over a low heat. Add the garlic, fresh chili and red pepper flakes and cook gently for 2 to 3 minutes, until the garlic is pale gold. Do not let it brown.
Add the drained spaghetti to the pan with a generous splash of the pasta water and toss over the heat for 1 minute until glossy.
Take off the heat, add the parsley, a squeeze of lemon, salt and pepper, and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Mango overnight oats
recipes.blurb: Creamy overnight oats made with yogurt and soft golden mango chunks.
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt and honey together in a bowl or two jars.
Fold in two-thirds of the mango, cover and chill overnight, or for at least 4 hours.
In the morning, loosen with a splash of milk if thick, top with the remaining mango and eat cold.

recipes.title: Creamy oatmeal
recipes.blurb: Slow-stirred oatmeal made with milk until thick, soft and creamy.
steps: Put the oats, milk and a tiny pinch of salt in a saucepan over a medium heat.
Bring to a gentle simmer, then turn the heat low and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring constantly, until thick and creamy.
Stir in the butter, let it stand for a minute, loosen with a splash of milk if needed, then serve hot with the honey drizzled over.

recipes.title: Three bean salad
recipes.blurb: Kidney beans, black beans and chickpeas tossed with crunchy pepper, carrot and red onion in a sharp dressing.
steps: Whisk the vinegar, olive oil, sugar, salt and pepper together in a large bowl.
Add all three beans, the peppers, carrot and red onion and toss until coated.
Stir in the parsley, then leave for 10 minutes (or chill for up to 2 days) so the beans soak up the dressing, and serve.
